title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
title_zh: TeamGym：面向分布式信息下AI智能体团队决策的训练场

paragraphs.en: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym , an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information . This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap ). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team’s success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap ). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 许多现实世界的决策需要团队整合分布于各参与者之间的信息。 然而AI智能体目前主要是在孤立状态下进行训练和评测的。 我们提出TeamGym，这是一个用于评测和训练基于语言模型的智能体的环境，其团队决策问题构建自真实世界的法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料。 TeamGym引入了一种识别最小事实集的方法，其中每个元素都是必要的，且所有元素合起来对正确的最终决策是充分的，我们称之为关键信息。 这使得TeamGym既能控制关键信息的分布，又能追踪智能体在进行团队决策时识别和整合关键信息的能力。 通过在12个源语料上考察8个语言模型，我们发现当前的AI智能体往往无法有效共享信息：与将相同信息提供给单个模型相比，将关键信息分散给多个参与者会使成功率平均降低22.9个百分点（即通信差距）。 我们还记录到参与者无法自行有效检索与决策相关的信息：当参与者必须从源材料中识别并提取关键信息而非直接获得时，团队的成功率会进一步降低19.9个百分点（即检索差距）。 为帮助弥补这些不足，我们使用TeamGym通过强化学习基于团队决策损失来训练策略。 在两项策略训练实验中，我们发现即使奖励只评估最终决策，训练仍能提升最终决策质量，并在参与、发言者选择和沟通方面诱导出涌现的协调行为。

paragraphs.en: The frontier of AI is turning to multi-agent systems, in which AI agents are organized into teams that communicate to solve problems ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) . Yet AI models are still trained and benchmarked largely as individual agents, which raises the question of whether they acquire the capacities and dispositions needed to be effective teammates. In human groups, collective intelligence, which is linked to social sensitivity and turn-taking, predicts team performance better than individual intelligence ( Woolley et al., 2010 ) . Although AI agents differ from humans, this finding motivates evaluating them as teams rather than only as individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的前沿正在转向多智能体系统，即把智能体组织成通过相互交流来解决问题的团队（Li et al., 2023；Wu et al., 2023；Hong et al., 2024；Kim et al., 2026a）。 然而人工智能模型在很大程度上仍然是作为单个智能体进行训练和基准测试的，这就引出了一个问题：它们是否具备成为高效队友所需的能力和特质。 在人类群体中，集体智能——它与社会敏感性和轮次交替相关——比个体智能更能预测团队表现（Woolley et al., 2010）。 尽管智能体与人类不同，但这一发现促使我们以团队而非仅仅以个体的方式来评估它们。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in team decision-making is that decision-relevant information is typically distributed across members. Reaching a collective decision requires members to identify and retrieve relevant information, communicate it efficiently, and integrate it into a final decision. Team theory has long studied this challenge ( Radner, 1962 ; Marschak and Radner, 1972 ) , while empirical research on human group decision-making finds that people often struggle to identify and integrate critical private information ( Stasser and Titus, 1985 ; Lu et al., 2012 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 团队决策中的一个核心挑战是，与决策相关的信息通常分布在各成员之间。 达成集体决策需要成员识别并提取相关信息，高效地进行沟通，并将其整合为最终决策。 团队理论长期研究这一挑战（Radner, 1962；Marschak and Radner, 1972），而关于人类群体决策的实证研究发现，人们往往难以识别和整合关键的私有信息（Stasser and Titus, 1985；Lu et al., 2012）。

sents.en: A central challenge in team decision-making is that decision-relevant information is typically distributed across members.
sents.zh: 团队决策中的一个核心挑战是，与决策相关的信息通常分布在各成员之间。

sents.en: Reaching a collective decision requires members to identify and retrieve relevant information, communicate it efficiently, and integrate it into a final decision.
sents.zh: 达成集体决策需要成员识别并提取相关信息，高效地进行沟通，并将其整合为最终决策。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TeamGym , a gym for constructing team decision problem instances from source corpora, and for evaluating and training participant and coordinator policies under controlled information distributions and communication structures. TeamGym targets questions that existing benchmarks and multi-agent systems leave open. Single-agent benchmarks measure individual model capabilities ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , while research on multi-agent LLM systems focuses on designing harnesses that solve a given problem ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026b ) . Neither offers much evidence on whether participants can retrieve and communicate decision-relevant information, how team performance varies with information distribution and communication structure, or whether training can improve participant and coordinator policies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TeamGym，这是一个用于从源语料库构建团队决策问题实例的 gym，用于在受控的信息分布和通信结构下评估和训练参与者与协调者策略。 TeamGym 针对的是现有基准和多智能体系统尚未解答的问题。 单智能体基准衡量的是单个模型的能力（Wu et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024），而关于多智能体 LLM 系统的研究则聚焦于设计解决给定问题的框架（Li et al., 2023；Wu et al., 2023；Hong et al., 2024；Kim et al., 2026b）。 两者都未能提供充分证据来回答：参与者能否检索并传达与决策相关的信息，团队绩效如何随信息分布和通信结构而变化，以及训练能否改进参与者与协调者的策略。

sents.en: We introduce TeamGym , a gym for constructing team decision problem instances from source corpora, and for evaluating and training participant and coordinator policies under controlled information distributions and communication structures.
sents.zh: 我们提出 TeamGym，这是一个用于从源语料库构建团队决策问题实例的 gym，用于在受控的信息分布和通信结构下评估和训练参与者与协调者策略。

paragraphs.en: TeamGym constructs controlled team decision problem instances from real-world source corpora. For each instance, it derives a decision objective from one or more corpus questions and either retains a corpus-provided reference decision or constructs one from corpus annotations and source materials. Source annotations and reasoning associated with the reference decision guide the selection of candidate evidence units, such as sentences, paragraphs, tables, or code blocks. Source-specific grounding and model-based complete-set and leave-one-out checks retain units that together support the reference decision but whose individual removal leaves it unsupported or unresolved. These retained units are pivotal information units (PIUs) and collectively form the instance’s pivotal information .
paragraphs.zh: TeamGym 从真实世界的源语料库中构建受控的团队决策问题实例。 对于每个实例，它从一个或多个语料库问题中导出决策目标，并保留语料库提供的参考决策，或者根据语料库标注和源材料构建一个参考决策。 与参考决策相关的源标注和推理过程用于指导候选证据单元（如句子、段落、表格或代码块）的选择。 借助针对特定来源的依据核验，以及基于模型的全集核验和留一法核验，保留那些共同支持参考决策、但单独移除任一单元会使参考决策失去支持或无法解决的单元。 这些保留的单元被称为关键信息单元（PIU），它们共同构成实例的关键信息。

sents.en: TeamGym constructs controlled team decision problem instances from real-world source corpora.
sents.zh: TeamGym 从真实世界的源语料库中构建受控的团队决策问题实例。

sents.zh: 这些保留的单元被称为关键信息单元（PIU），它们共同构成实例的关键信息。

paragraphs.en: Holding the problem instance and its pivotal information fixed, TeamGym can vary who initially has each PIU (the PIU distribution ), whether participants receive PIUs directly or source material containing them, the communication structure, and token budgets. The team collectively receives the pivotal information, but the evidence is distributed across participants to make communication necessary for a fully supported final decision. The communication structure specifies whether a coordinator controls communication, how speakers are selected, and which decision maker makes the final decision. Token budgets constrain what decision makers may observe and generate. To understand what reduces team performance, we define two success-rate gaps. The communication gap is the drop when the same PIUs are distributed across participants rather than given to one model. The retrieval gap is the further drop when the team must retrieve those PIUs from source material rather than receive them directly. Beyond evaluation, TeamGym supports training participant and coordinator policies under controlled PIU distributions, communication structures, and token budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 在固定问题实例及其关键信息的前提下，TeamGym 可以改变初始时谁持有每个 PIU（即 PIU 分布）、参与者是直接接收 PIU 还是接收包含它们的原始材料、沟通结构以及 token 预算。 团队整体接收关键信息，但证据分布在各参与者之间，使得沟通对于形成有充分依据的最终决策成为必要。 沟通结构规定了是否由一个协调者控制沟通、如何选择发言者，以及由哪个决策者做出最终决策。 Token 预算限制了决策者可以观察和生成的内容。 为了理解什么因素会降低团队绩效，我们定义了两个成功率差距。 沟通差距是指当相同的 PIU 分布在多个参与者之间而非交给一个模型时，成功率的下降。 检索差距是指当团队必须从原始材料中检索这些 PIU 而非直接接收它们时，成功率的进一步下降。 除评估之外，TeamGym 还支持在受控的 PIU 分布、沟通结构和 token 预算下训练参与者与协调者的策略。

sents.zh: 在固定问题实例及其关键信息的前提下，TeamGym 可以改变初始时谁持有每个 PIU（即 PIU 分布）、参与者是直接接收 PIU 还是接收包含它们的原始材料、沟通结构以及 token 预算。

sents.zh: 团队整体接收关键信息，但证据分布在各参与者之间，使得沟通对于形成有充分依据的最终决策成为必要。

sents.zh: 沟通差距是指当相同的 PIU 分布在多个参与者之间而非交给一个模型时，成功率的下降。

paragraphs.en: The resulting comparisons hold the problem instance and pivotal information fixed to isolate communication and retrieval effects from differences in problem difficulty. (1) Across eight language models and 12 source corpora, the decision success rate is 22.9 percentage points lower when the same PIUs are distributed across a team than when one model receives them all, and a further 19.9 points lower when the same team must retrieve its PIUs from source material rather than receiving them directly. (2) Across domains, differences in the success rate among communication structures vary across PIU-distribution conditions. For example, across the six legal source corpora when participants receive PIUs directly, sequential communication in which each speaker selects the next participant leads simultaneous communication by 3.9 points when one PIU is initially common to the team, but trails it by 9.8 points when the team includes an additional participant without a PIU, corresponding to a 13.8-point change in the difference between their success rates. (3) Optimizing final-decision quality changes the communication process itself. With coordinator control, joint two-policy training produces a compact, exhaustive information-elicitation protocol; without a coordinator, training the shared participant policy improves end-to-end final-decision quality and completion and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication. Tracing PIUs through these trajectories shows that increased participation makes more pivotal information available on FinDVer validation, but not on held-out FinLongDocQA.
paragraphs.zh: 由此产生的比较将问题实例和关键信息固定不变，从而将沟通与检索的影响同问题难度的差异区分开来。 （1）在八个语言模型和12个源语料库中，当相同的PIU分布在团队中而非由一个智能体全部接收时，决策成功率低22.9个百分点；而当同一团队必须从源材料中检索其PIU而非直接接收时，成功率再低19.9个百分点。 （2）跨领域来看，不同沟通结构之间的成功率差异在不同PIU分布条件下有所变化。 例如，在六个法律源语料库中，当参与者直接接收PIU时，如果团队最初共享一个PIU，由每个发言者选择下一位参与者的顺序沟通比同步沟通高3.9分；但当团队包含一名没有PIU的额外参与者时，则比同步沟通低9.8分，对应于二者成功率之差变化13.8分。 （3）对最终决策质量的优化会改变沟通过程本身。 在有协调者控制的情况下，联合双策略训练产生了一种紧凑且详尽的信息获取协议；在没有协调者的情况下，训练共享的参与者策略提升了端到端的最终决策质量和完成率，并在参与、发言者选择和沟通方面诱导出涌现式的协调。 通过这些轨迹追踪PIU可以发现，更多的参与使FinDVer验证集上有更多关键信息可用，但在留出的FinLongDocQA上并非如此。

paragraphs.en: TeamGym therefore provides a controlled environment in which team decision-making capabilities can be evaluated and trained under different information distributions and communication structures.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，TeamGym 提供了一个可控的环境，可以在不同的信息分布和沟通结构下评估和训练团队的决策能力。

paragraphs.en: Team decision theory studies cooperative decision makers with a team objective and a decentralized information structure. A team problem couples a shared objective with an information structure and one policy for each decision maker ( Radner, 1962 ; Marschak and Radner, 1972 ; Yüksel and Başar, 2013 ) . Classical analysis largely studies the properties of different computation structures and policies, not how they can be learned and implemented computationally. Under tractable joint-policy optimization (A1) , computing this collection is assumed feasible before execution, although the exact problem can be intractable even in finite-horizon decentralized control ( Bernstein et al., 2002 ) . TeamGym instead evaluates and trains language-model policies, comparing policy collections before and after training under the same conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 团队决策理论研究具有团队目标和分散式信息结构的合作型决策者。 团队问题将共享目标与信息结构以及每个决策者的一个策略耦合在一起（Radner, 1962；Marschak and Radner, 1972；Yüksel and Başar, 2013）。 经典分析主要研究不同计算结构和策略的性质，而不是研究它们如何通过计算被学习与实现。 在可处理的联合策略优化（A1）下，该集合的计算被假定在执行前是可行的，尽管即使是在有限时域的分散式控制中，该精确问题也可能是难以处理的（Bernstein et al., 2002）。 TeamGym 则评估并训练语言模型策略，在相同条件下比较训练前后的策略集合。

paragraphs.en: Under the direct-report mechanism assumption (A2) , mechanism design represents private information as a type that can be elicited directly under the applicable equilibrium assumptions, and that participants know their type and can communicate it if they so choose ( Maskin and Sjostrom, 2002 ; Myerson, 1979 ; Myerson, 2008 ) . In practice, however, attention and cognitive limitations constrain agent’s ability to identify, extract, and communicate information contained in long source material, even if it is in principle available to them ( Mookherjee, 2006 ) . TeamGym assumes a shared team payoff and studies bounded natural-language messages derived from source material.
paragraphs.zh: 在直接汇报机制假设（A2）下，机制设计将私人信息表示为一种类型，该类型可以在相应的均衡假设下被直接引出，并且参与者知道自己的类型，并且如果愿意可以选择将其传递出去（Maskin and Sjostrom, 2002；Myerson, 1979；Myerson, 2008）。 然而在实践中，注意力和认知限制会约束智能体识别、提取并传递长篇源材料中所含信息的能力，即使这些信息在原则上是其可以获取的（Mookherjee, 2006）。 TeamGym 假设团队收益是共享的，并研究由源材料导出的有界自然语言消息。

paragraphs.en: Research in organizational economics, planning, and reinforcement learning examines communication costs and message limits ( Cremer et al., 2007 ; Wu et al., 2011 ; Kim et al., 2019 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) . The idealization of nonbinding communication resources (A3) permits decision makers to access and transmit relevant information without binding observation or message constraints. TeamGym instead makes its resource budgets explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 组织经济学、规划与强化学习领域的研究考察了通信成本与消息限制（Cremer et al., 2007；Wu et al., 2011；Kim et al., 2019；Zhu et al., 2024）。 对非约束性通信资源（A3）的理想化设定允许决策者在不受观测或消息约束的情况下获取和传输相关信息。 TeamGym 则明确规定了其资源预算。

paragraphs.en: We defer additional related work on multistage communication, human-AI and group decision making, multi-agent LLM systems, benchmark contrasts, and the source corpora to Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将关于多阶段通信、人机协作与群体决策、多智能体大语言模型系统、基准对比以及源语料库的其他相关工作推迟至第 6 节讨论。

paragraphs.en: We formalize TeamGym as a finite-horizon team decision problem ( Radner, 1962 ; Marschak and Radner, 1972 ; Yüksel and Başar, 2013 ; Nayyar et al., 2013 ) . A problem instance q q fixes underlying source materials, a decision objective, a decision format, a set 𝒟 q \mathcal{D}_{q} of possible final decisions, and a problem-specific evaluator that assigns each d ∈ 𝒟 q d\in\mathcal{D}_{q} a team payoff U q ​ ( d ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] U_{q}(d)\in[0,1] . A decision maker is a role whose policy may generate a query, send a message, or make the final decision. A participant is a decision maker that may send messages during communication. A coordinator is a decision maker that may control communication by selecting or querying participants and may make the final decision. Initially, each participant receives an initial local observation, while all decision makers receive the same initial common observation containing the decision objective and decision format. The policy ρ i \rho_{i} maps the information currently available to decision maker i i to a distribution over the queries, messages, or final decisions permitted for its role; ρ \rho denotes the collection of decision-maker policies. The communication structure 𝒞 \mathcal{C} specifies whether a coordinator controls communication, which participants may send messages and when, whether messages are sequential or simultaneous, and which decision maker makes the final decision. The resource budgets B B , including token budgets, constrain what decision makers may observe and generate and how often participants may send messages. Queries and messages form the communication transcript ; a decision maker’s local transcript is the portion available to it under 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and B B . The initial local and common observations, together with the observation rules induced by 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and the observation limits in B B , define the decentralized information structure . An episode is one complete execution through the final-decision stage for fixed q q , initial observations, 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , B B , and ρ \rho . For these fixed inputs, the resulting interaction induces a distribution over final decisions, and we evaluate ρ \rho by its expected team payoff, 𝔼 ​ [ U q ​ ( d ) ] \mathbb{E}[U_{q}(d)] . Holding q q and the initial observations fixed while varying 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , B B , or ρ \rho changes the interaction conditions without changing the problem instance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 TeamGym 形式化为一个有限时域的团队决策问题（Radner, 1962；Marschak and Radner, 1972；Yüksel and Başar, 2013；Nayyar et al., 2013）。 问题实例 q q 确定底层源材料、决策目标、决策格式、可能的最终决策集合 𝒟 q \mathcal{D}_{q} ，以及一个针对具体问题的评估器，该评估器为每个 d ∈ 𝒟 q d\in\mathcal{D}_{q} 赋予团队收益 U q ( d ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] U_{q}(d)\in[0,1] 。 决策者是一种角色，其策略可以生成查询、发送消息或做出最终决策。 参与者是可以在沟通过程中发送消息的决策者。 协调者是可以通过选择或查询参与者来控制沟通，并且可以做出最终决策的决策者。 初始时，每个参与者收到一个初始局部观测，而所有决策者收到相同的初始共同观测，其中包含决策目标和决策格式。 策略 ρ i \rho_{i} 将决策者 i i 当前可获得的信息映射为其角色所允许的查询、消息或最终决策上的一个分布； ρ \rho 表示所有决策者策略的集合。 沟通结构 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 规定是否有协调者控制沟通、哪些参与者可以发送消息以及何时发送、消息是顺序的还是同时的，以及由哪个决策者做出最终决策。 资源预算 B B（包括 token 预算）约束决策者可以观测和生成的内容，以及参与者可以发送消息的频率。 查询和消息构成沟通记录（communication transcript）；某决策者的局部记录是指在 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 和 B B 之下其可获得的记录部分。 初始局部观测和共同观测，连同由 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 引出的观测规则以及 B B 中的观测限制，共同定义了去中心化信息结构。 一回合（episode）是指在固定的 q q 、初始观测、 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 、 B B 和 ρ \rho 之下，直到最终决策阶段的完整执行过程。 对于这些固定的输入，由此产生的交互在最终决策上诱导出一个分布，我们用期望团队收益 𝔼 [ U q ( d ) ] \mathbb{E}[U_{q}(d)] 来评估 ρ \rho 。 在保持 q q 和初始观测固定的情况下，改变 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 、 B B 或 ρ \rho 会改变交互条件，而不改变问题实例本身。

paragraphs.en: For evaluation, we consider five communication structures (Figure 2 ), each proceeding in scheduled steps called communication rounds : (1) Round robin , under which one participant sends a message per round in a fixed cyclic order; (2) Current-speaker selection , which starts with the first participant in that order, after which each speaker selects the next participant; (3) Simultaneous responses , under which all participants respond in one round; (4) Coordinator-selected speaker , under which the coordinator selects and queries one participant per round; and (5) Broadcast query , under which the coordinator sends the same query to all participants, whose responses are generated in the same round. In Round robin, Current-speaker selection, and Simultaneous responses, no coordinator controls communication, and a separate final decision maker that does not participate in communication reads the complete communication transcript and makes the final decision. In Coordinator-selected speaker and Broadcast query, the coordinator controls communication and makes the final decision. Appendix C provides message-generation and implementation details and connections to prior work.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估中，我们考虑五种通信结构（图2），每种结构按称为通信轮次的预定步骤进行：（1）轮询，即每轮由一名参与者按固定的循环顺序发送一条消息；（2）当前发言者选择，即从该顺序中的第一位参与者开始，之后每位发言者选择下一位参与者；（3）同时响应，即所有参与者在同一轮内作出响应；（4）协调者选定发言者，即协调者每轮选择并询问一名参与者；（5）广播查询，即协调者向所有参与者发送相同的查询，其响应在同一轮内生成。 在轮询、当前发言者选择和同时响应中，没有协调者控制通信，由一名不参与通信的独立最终决策者阅读完整的通信记录并作出最终决策。 在协调者选定发言者和广播查询中，协调者控制通信并作出最终决策。 附录C提供了消息生成与实现细节，以及与先前工作的联系。

paragraphs.en: TeamGym constructs each problem instance q q from one source corpus using materials such as contracts, SEC filings, biomedical papers, or source code. Each q q is paired with a reference decision d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} supported by its source materials and used in construction and evaluation. For each q q , we identify an inclusion-minimal set ℐ q min = { i 1 , … , i k } \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q}=\{i_{1},\ldots,i_{k}\} called its pivotal information ; each i j i_{j} is a pivotal information unit (PIU) . Informally, this information is sufficient to determine a final decision that achieves the highest possible team payoff, whereas removing any one PIU leaves insufficient information to guarantee such a decision. Because DeepSWE admits multiple valid patches and costly repository execution, it instead uses functional PIUs validated under a fixed, bounded protocol (Appendix D.6.4 ). Appendix D.1 formalizes this definition.
paragraphs.zh: TeamGym 从单一源语料库（如合同、SEC 文件、生物医学论文或源代码等材料）构建每个问题实例 q。 每个 q 都配有一个参考决策 d^{ref}，该决策由其源材料支持，并用于构建与评估。 对于每个 q，我们确定一个包含最少的集合 ℐ_q^{min}={i_1,…,i_k}，称为其关键信息；每个 i_j 都是一个关键信息单元（PIU）。 非正式地说，这些信息足以确定一个能获得最高可能团队收益的最终决策，而移除任何一个 PIU 都会使信息不足以保证这样的决策。 由于 DeepSWE 允许多个有效补丁且仓库执行代价高昂，它改为使用在固定、有界协议下验证的功能性 PIU（附录 D.6.4）。 附录 D.1 对该定义进行了形式化。

paragraphs.en: When a model’s reasoning trace used to produce d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} is available, we retain it; otherwise, we generate reasoning conditioned on d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} , following answer-conditioned rationale generation ( Wang et al., 2023a ) . To identify ℐ q min \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q} , we use source annotations and the retained or generated reasoning to locate candidate units in the source materials. Grounding and model-based checks then test whether the candidates together support d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} and whether removing any one leaves the final decision unsupported or unresolved. The candidates retained by these checks form ℐ q min \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q} . We then verify that a model given all pivotal information can solve each evaluated problem instance (Section 4.1 ). Appendix D.7 reports an additional re-check of PIU necessity on representative instances using a model not used for construction.
paragraphs.zh: 当用于生成 d^{\mathrm{ref}} 的模型推理轨迹可用时，我们予以保留；否则，我们以 d^{\mathrm{ref}} 为条件生成推理，遵循答案条件下的理据生成方法（Wang et al., 2023a）。 为确定 \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q}，我们利用来源标注以及保留或生成的推理，在来源材料中定位候选单元。 随后通过依据核查和基于模型的检验，测试这些候选单元合起来是否支持 d^{\mathrm{ref}}，以及移除其中任何一个是否会使最终决策失去支持或无法判定。 通过这些检验保留下来的候选单元即构成 \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q}。 然后我们验证一个获得全部关键信息的模型能否求解每个被评估的问题实例（见 4.1 节）。 附录 D.7 报告了使用一个未参与构建的模型，在代表性实例上对 PIU 必要性进行的额外复查。

paragraphs.en: A PIU distribution specifies who initially has each PIU in ℐ q min \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q} : a PIU may be assigned to one or more participants through their initial local observations or placed in the initial common observation shared by the team. Figure 4 defines and illustrates five conditions. For a fixed q q , the conditions vary the PIU distribution while keeping the pivotal information and d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} unchanged. The initial common observation may also include participant descriptions , which summarize participants’ subject matter or function without revealing their assigned PIUs and can inform speaker selection.
paragraphs.zh: PIU 分布规定 ℐ q min \mathcal{I}^{\min}_{q} 中每个 PIU 最初由谁持有：一个 PIU 可以通过参与者的初始局部观察分配给一个或多个参与者，也可以置于团队共享的初始共同观察中。 图 4 定义并展示了五个条件。 对于固定的 q q ，各条件在保持关键信息和 d ref d^{\mathrm{ref}} 不变的情况下改变 PIU 分布。 初始共同观察还可以包含参与者描述，这些描述概括参与者的主题或职能而不泄露其被分配的 PIU，并可用于发言者选择。

paragraphs.en: Rather than receiving PIUs directly, participants’ initial observations may contain portions of the contracts, filings, papers, or source code used to construct q q . We divide this source material into units without dividing a PIU, assign PIU-containing units according to the fixed PIU distribution, and distribute the remaining units across participants. For every problem instance, we then verify that no participant can produce a correct final decision from its initial local observation and the initial common observation. Appendix D.7 reports an additional re-check of this requirement on representative instances using a model not used for construction. Appendix D provides the formal source terminology and source-specific construction and distribution procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者的初始观察并非直接接收 PIU，而是可能包含用于构建 q q 的部分合约、备案文件、论文或源代码。 我们将此类源材料划分成单元时不拆分任何 PIU，按照固定的 PIU 分布分配包含 PIU 的单元，并将剩余单元分配给参与者。 对于每个问题实例，我们随后验证没有任何参与者能够仅凭其初始局部观察和初始共同观察得出正确的最终决策。 附录 D.7 报告了使用一个未参与构建的模型对代表性实例进行该要求的附加复核。 附录 D 提供了正式的源术语以及针对各源的具体构建与分配流程。

paragraphs.en: A problem family groups problem instances constructed from the same source corpus that require the same general kind of work and use the same evaluation procedure. For a problem family with a binary success criterion, episode success rate is the proportion of episodes whose final decisions succeed. Depending on the problem family, final decisions are compared with reference decisions or assessed by an LLM judge using problem-specific criteria. Software-engineering patches are checked by an official repository verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 问题族将源自同一语料库构建、需要同类总体工作并使用相同评估程序的问题实例归为一组。 对于具有二元成功标准的问题族，回合成功率为最终决策成功的回合所占比例。 根据问题族的不同，最终决策或与参考决策进行比较，或由 LLM 裁判依据问题特定标准进行评估。 软件工程补丁由官方仓库验证器进行检查。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate LLMs on problem instances constructed from legal, finance, medical, and software-engineering source corpora under three evaluation conditions: (1) Single-Agent All-PIU , in which one model receives all PIUs and makes the final decision; (2) Multi-Agent PIU-Only , in which the PIUs are distributed directly across participants; and (3) Multi-Agent Full-Context , in which the same participants instead receive source material containing their assigned PIUs. For each problem instance and LLM, the three conditions share the same PIUs and evaluator; the two multi-agent conditions also share the same PIU distribution, communication structure, and resource budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在由法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料构建的问题实例上评估大语言模型（LLM），并在三种评估条件下进行：(1) 单智能体全PIU，即由一个模型接收所有PIU并做出最终决策；(2) 多智能体仅PIU，即PIU直接分配给各个参与者；以及(3) 多智能体全上下文，即相同的参与者改为接收包含其被分配PIU的源材料。 对于每个问题实例和每个LLM，三种条件共享相同的PIU和评估器；两个多智能体条件还共享相同的PIU分配、通信结构和资源预算。

paragraphs.en: For this cross-domain comparison, both multi-agent conditions use One PIU per participant (Figure 4 ) and Coordinator-selected speaker. The communication gap is the decrease in episode success rate from Single-Agent All-PIU to Multi-Agent PIU-Only, and the retrieval gap is the additional decrease from Multi-Agent PIU-Only to Multi-Agent Full-Context. With the model and problem instance fixed, larger gaps indicate greater difficulty communicating and integrating distributed PIUs (communication gap) and retrieving them from source material (retrieval gap), rather than differences in model knowledge. The retrieval contrast corresponds to a departure from A2 , and the communication contrast corresponds to a departure from A3 . Figure 6 reports the episode success rates used to compute these gaps. Appendix E additionally reports Single-Agent Full-Context , in which one model receives all participants’ source material combined in participant order, removing team communication while retaining retrieval from source material.

paragraphs.en: Strong individual problem-solving does not guarantee effective teamwork: across all four domains, we observe substantial communication and retrieval gaps, although their magnitudes vary across domains and models. Single-Agent All-PIU reflects individual reasoning and decision-making capability when all pivotal information is directly available, but this individual performance does not by itself predict the model’s ability to communicate and integrate PIUs distributed across participants or to retrieve them from source material for team communication and integration.
paragraphs.zh: 强大的个人问题解决能力并不能保证高效的团队协作：在全部四个领域中，我们都观察到了显著的沟通与检索差距，尽管其幅度因领域和模型而异。 Single-Agent All-PIU 反映的是在所有关键信息都可直接获取时智能体的个人推理与决策能力，但这种个人表现本身并不能预测该模型在沟通与整合分布于各参与者之间的关键信息单元（PIU）、或为团队沟通与整合从原始材料中检索这些信息单元方面的能力。

paragraphs.en: Communication structure may affect episode success rate by changing the information supplied to the final decision maker. We examine two mechanisms through which access to earlier participant messages can change this input: correct synthesis and error uptake . Here, correct synthesis refers to an auditor-labeled, reference-supported inference that combines information. The intended criterion requires at least two distinct PIUs, but the current labels also include some inferences combining one PIU with information from the publicly visible decision options (Appendix E.4.2 ). Error uptake occurs when a later participant uses an incorrect or unsupported claim from an earlier visible message; rejecting or correcting that claim does not count.
paragraphs.zh: 沟通结构可能通过改变提供给最终决策者的信息来影响回合成功率。 我们考察了两种机制，通过这两种机制，访问更早参与者的消息可以改变这一输入：正确综合与错误吸纳。 在此，正确综合指的是一种由审核员标注、有参考支持并结合信息的推理。 预期标准要求至少包含两个不同的信息单元（PIU），但当前的标注也包含了一些将单个信息单元与公开可见的决策选项中的信息相结合的推理（附录 E.4.2）。 当较晚的参与者使用了更早可见消息中不正确或无依据的断言时，即发生错误吸纳；拒绝或纠正该断言则不计入。

paragraphs.en: We analyze Multi-Agent PIU-Only under One PIU per participant. In this setting, Round robin and Current-speaker selection achieve higher episode success rates than Simultaneous responses when the same Qwen3 model is used for the participants and the final decision maker. When only the final decision maker is replaced with GPT-5.5, however, the ordering reverses: Simultaneous responses achieves the highest rate . We use frozen participant trajectories to test how adding correct synthesis and removing error uptake affect episode success. A separate GPT-5.5 auditor labels sentence-level components. Participants are not rerun; we reconstruct the transcript input and regenerate only the final decision. Appendix E.4.1 reports the complete design and sample sizes. To isolate these mechanisms, we add correct synthesis while holding the PIUs supplied to the final decision maker fixed and excluding sentences that directly state a final choice or answer; separately, we remove only later sentences that use an earlier error while retaining the original error (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在「每个参与者一个 PIU」的设置下分析多智能体 PIU-Only。 在该设置中，当参与者和最终决策者使用同一个 Qwen3 模型时，轮询和当前发言者选择比同时响应取得更高的回合成功率。 然而，当仅把最终决策者替换为 GPT-5.5 时，排序发生反转：同时响应取得最高的成功率。 我们使用冻结的参与者轨迹来测试添加正确综合与移除错误采纳如何影响回合成功率。 由一个单独的 GPT-5.5 审计者标注句子级成分。 参与者不重新运行；我们重建转录输入，仅重新生成最终决策。 附录 E.4.1 报告了完整的设计与样本量。 为隔离这些机制，我们在保持提供给最终决策者的 PIU 不变并排除直接陈述最终选择或答案的句子的同时，添加正确综合；另外，我们仅移除使用较早错误的后续句子，同时保留原始错误（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: Access to earlier participant messages can improve decisions through correct synthesis or impair them through error uptake. The effects of both mechanisms depend in part on which model makes the final decision. Adding correct synthesis increases episode success rate in all four conditions, but replacing only the final decision maker with GPT-5.5 reduces its effect. Removing error uptake has a statistically significant effect only for Qwen3-235B participants, and its effect is smaller than the correct-synthesis effect in every condition. Appendix E.4 describes how correct synthesis and error uptake are identified and how each intervention is constructed.
paragraphs.zh: 访问较早的参与者消息可以通过正确的综合改善决策，也可能因吸收错误而损害决策。 这两种机制的影响在一定程度上取决于由哪个模型做出最终决策。 增加正确综合在所有四种条件下都能提高回合成功率，但仅将最终决策者替换为 GPT-5.5 会削弱其效果。 移除错误吸收仅在 Qwen3-235B 参与者的情况下具有统计显著性，且其在每种条件下的影响都小于正确综合的影响。 附录 E.4 描述了如何识别正确综合与错误吸收，以及如何构建每种干预措施。

paragraphs.en: We examine two mechanisms in finance and SARA through matched comparisons and interventions; these do not estimate how much of the cross-domain regression interaction either mechanism explains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过匹配比较和干预检验了金融与 SARA 中的两种机制；这些方法并未估计任一机制对跨领域回归交互效应的解释比例。

paragraphs.en: Across 59 finance problem instances, pooling Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B, the advantage of Round robin over Coordinator-selected speaker is larger under All-but-one PIU concentration : 31.4 percentage points, compared with 17.8 under One PIU per participant. The resulting + 13.6 +13.6 -point interaction is statistically significant. Yet 99.2% of required participants speak in the concentrated condition. Under Coordinator-selected speaker, the selected participant receives a specific query. Its public description summarizes its subject matter or function without listing its assigned PIU categories, so the query may request only part of its evidence. Under Round robin, participants respond to the whole problem without a coordinator query. We therefore test whether broadening or removing the query reduces the communication-structure interaction when speaker selection is fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 在59个金融问题实例上，将Qwen3-32B与Qwen3-235B-A22B合并统计，在「除一人外全员PIU集中」的条件下，轮询相对于协调者选人的优势更大：领先31.4个百分点，而「每人一个PIU」条件下为17.8个百分点。 由此产生的+13.6个百分点的交互效应在统计上显著。 然而在集中条件下，99.2%的必需参与者都发了言。 在协调者选人条件下，被选中的参与者会收到一个具体的查询。 其公开描述只概述其主题或功能，而不列出其被分配的PIU类别，因此该查询可能只要求其提供部分证据。 在轮询条件下，参与者直接对整个问题作出回应，无需协调者查询。 因此，我们检验在说话者选择方式固定的情况下，放宽或取消查询是否能减小通信结构带来的交互效应。

sents.en: Across 59 finance problem instances, pooling Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B, the advantage of Round robin over Coordinator-selected speaker is larger under All-but-one PIU concentration : 31.4 percentage points, compared with 17.8 under One PIU per participant.

sents.en: The resulting + 13.6 +13.6 -point interaction is statistically significant.
sents.zh: 由此产生的+13.6个百分点的交互效应在统计上显著。

sents.en: Yet 99.2% of required participants speak in the concentrated condition.
sents.zh: 然而在集中条件下，99.2%的必需参与者都发了言。

sents.en: Under Coordinator-selected speaker, the selected participant receives a specific query.
sents.zh: 在协调者选人条件下，被选中的参与者会收到一个具体的查询。

sents.en: Its public description summarizes its subject matter or function without listing its assigned PIU categories, so the query may request only part of its evidence.
sents.zh: 其公开描述只概述其主题或功能，而不列出其被分配的PIU类别，因此该查询可能只要求其提供部分证据。

sents.en: Under Round robin, participants respond to the whole problem without a coordinator query.

sents.en: We therefore test whether broadening or removing the query reduces the communication-structure interaction when speaker selection is fixed.
sents.zh: 因此，我们检验在说话者选择方式固定的情况下，放宽或取消查询是否能减小通信结构带来的交互效应。

paragraphs.en: We fix speaker selection, order, response count, private source material, and budgets. After selection, we append public PIU category labels that identify the topics of the selected participant’s assigned PIUs, with an instruction to report evidence for each category. The existing public participant description remains unchanged; the labels disclose no private facts, values, or answers. Messages and final decisions are regenerated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们固定发言者选择、顺序、回复次数、私有源材料和预算。 选择完成后，我们附加公开的 PIU 类别标签，用以标明被选参与者所分配 PIU 的主题，并附上指示，要求为每个类别报告证据。 已有的公开参与者描述保持不变；这些标签不泄露任何私有事实、值或答案。 消息和最终决策将被重新生成。

sents.en: We fix speaker selection, order, response count, private source material, and budgets.
sents.zh: 我们固定发言者选择、顺序、回复次数、私有源材料和预算。

sents.en: After selection, we append public PIU category labels that identify the topics of the selected participant’s assigned PIUs, with an instruction to report evidence for each category.

paragraphs.en: We also replace the query with “It is your turn to contribute,” with and without the additions. Holding the original Round robin outcomes fixed, we recalculate the communication-structure interaction for each coordinator query condition. The original-query replay gives + 15.5 +15.5 points; Table 4 reports this 2 × 2 2\times 2 comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将查询替换为“轮到你发言了”，分别在加入与不加入这些补充内容的情况下进行。 在保持原始轮转（Round robin）结果不变的情况下，我们针对每种协调者查询条件重新计算沟通结构的交互效应。 原始查询的重放结果为 +15.5 分；表 4 报告了这一 2×2 对比。

sents.en: We also replace the query with “It is your turn to contribute,” with and without the additions.
sents.zh: 我们还将查询替换为“轮到你发言了”，分别在加入与不加入这些补充内容的情况下进行。

sents.en: Holding the original Round robin outcomes fixed, we recalculate the communication-structure interaction for each coordinator query condition.
sents.zh: 在保持原始轮转（Round robin）结果不变的情况下，我们针对每种协调者查询条件重新计算沟通结构的交互效应。

sents.en: The original-query replay gives + 15.5 +15.5 points; Table 4 reports this 2 × 2 2\times 2 comparison.
sents.zh: 原始查询的重放结果为 +15.5 分；表 4 报告了这一 2×2 对比。

paragraphs.en: Narrow coordinator queries contribute to the larger loss from PIU concentration under Coordinator-selected speaker. Adding the labels and instruction reduces the interaction from + 15.5 +15.5 to + 5.9 +5.9 points. Query removal changes it to − 5.4 -5.4 points without additions and − 9.3 -9.3 with them. All three changes from the original-query replay are statistically significant; none of the resulting interactions is significant. Both interventions selectively increase substantive PIU communication. These results support a role for query content, without establishing a zero residual interaction or separate effects of the labels and instruction. Appendix E.7.1 – E.7.2 reports the design, success rates, and inference.
paragraphs.zh: 狭窄的协调员查询在协调员选择的发言者条件下加剧了 PIU 集中带来的更大损失。 添加标签和指令使交互从 +15.5 降低到 +5.9 个百分点。 移除查询后，在不添加标签和指令时该交互变为 −5.4 个百分点，添加后为 −9.3 个百分点。 原始查询重放中的这三项变化在统计上均显著；由此产生的交互均不显著。 两种干预都选择性地增加了实质性的 PIU 交流。 这些结果支持了查询内容的作用，但并未确立零残余交互，也未区分标签和指令的各自效应。 附录 E.7.1 – E.7.2 报告了实验设计、成功率和统计推断。

sents.en: Narrow coordinator queries contribute to the larger loss from PIU concentration under Coordinator-selected speaker.
sents.zh: 狭窄的协调员查询在协调员选择的发言者条件下加剧了 PIU 集中带来的更大损失。

sents.en: Adding the labels and instruction reduces the interaction from + 15.5 +15.5 to + 5.9 +5.9 points.
sents.zh: 添加标签和指令使交互从 +15.5 降低到 +5.9 个百分点。

sents.en: Query removal changes it to − 5.4 -5.4 points without additions and − 9.3 -9.3 with them.
sents.zh: 移除查询后，在不添加标签和指令时该交互变为 −5.4 个百分点，添加后为 −9.3 个百分点。

sents.en: All three changes from the original-query replay are statistically significant; none of the resulting interactions is significant.
sents.zh: 原始查询重放中的这三项变化在统计上均显著；由此产生的交互均不显著。

sents.en: Both interventions selectively increase substantive PIU communication.
sents.zh: 两种干预都选择性地增加了实质性的 PIU 交流。

sents.en: These results support a role for query content, without establishing a zero residual interaction or separate effects of the labels and instruction.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持了查询内容的作用，但并未确立零残余交互，也未区分标签和指令的各自效应。

sents.en: Appendix E.7.1 – E.7.2 reports the design, success rates, and inference.
sents.zh: 附录 E.7.1 – E.7.2 报告了实验设计、成功率和统计推断。

paragraphs.en: In the cross-domain Multi-Agent Full-Context regression, All-but-one PIU concentration shifts the comparison between Simultaneous responses and Coordinator-selected speaker by 4.0 percentage points toward the latter relative to One PIU per participant. This interaction is statistically significant. Source material could impair participants assigned PIUs or cause participants assigned no PIU to produce harmful messages. We examine these possibilities across 44 SARA problem instances, pooling Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-235B-A22B, and GPT-5.5. We first compare Multi-Agent PIU-Only with a condition that adds the original private source material. In both conditions, participants receive their assigned PIUs explicitly as facts relevant to the decision; in Multi-Agent Full-Context, they must instead retrieve those facts from the source material. This comparison tests whether adding source material changes the interaction even when the relevant facts are already supplied directly. In Multi-Agent PIU-Only, the advantage of Simultaneous responses over Coordinator-selected speaker is 10.6 percentage points larger under All-but-one PIU concentration than under One PIU per participant. Adding source material changes this interaction to − 5.1 -5.1 points, a statistically significant change of − 15.7 -15.7 points.
paragraphs.zh: 在跨领域多智能体全上下文回归中，「除一人外均有 PIU」的集中方式相对于「每名参与者一个 PIU」使「同时回答」与「协调者选定发言者」之间的比较向后者偏移 4.0 个百分点。 这一交互作用在统计上显著。 源材料可能损害被分配了 PIU 的参与者，或导致未被分配 PIU 的参与者产生有害信息。 我们在 44 个 SARA 问题实例上检验这些可能性，汇总 Qwen3-32B、Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 GPT-5.5 的结果。 我们首先将多智能体仅 PIU 条件与加入原始私有源材料的条件进行比较。 在两种条件下，参与者都会以与决策相关的事实的明确形式收到其被分配的 PIU；而在多智能体全上下文中，他们必须改为从源材料中检索这些事实。 这一比较检验的是，在相关事实已被直接提供的情况下，加入源材料是否会改变交互作用。 在多智能体仅 PIU 条件下，「同时回答」相对于「协调者选定发言者」的优势在「除一人外均有 PIU」集中方式下比在「每名参与者一个 PIU」下大 10.6 个百分点。 加入源材料使这一交互作用变为 −5.1 分，即发生了 −15.7 分的统计上显著的变化。

sents.en: In the cross-domain Multi-Agent Full-Context regression, All-but-one PIU concentration shifts the comparison between Simultaneous responses and Coordinator-selected speaker by 4.0 percentage points toward the latter relative to One PIU per participant.
sents.zh: 在跨领域多智能体全上下文回归中，「除一人外均有 PIU」的集中方式相对于「每名参与者一个 PIU」使「同时回答」与「协调者选定发言者」之间的比较向后者偏移 4.0 个百分点。

sents.en: This interaction is statistically significant.
sents.zh: 这一交互作用在统计上显著。

sents.en: Source material could impair participants assigned PIUs or cause participants assigned no PIU to produce harmful messages.
sents.zh: 源材料可能损害被分配了 PIU 的参与者，或导致未被分配 PIU 的参与者产生有害信息。

sents.en: We examine these possibilities across 44 SARA problem instances, pooling Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-235B-A22B, and GPT-5.5.
sents.zh: 我们在 44 个 SARA 问题实例上检验这些可能性，汇总 Qwen3-32B、Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 GPT-5.5 的结果。

sents.en: We first compare Multi-Agent PIU-Only with a condition that adds the original private source material.
sents.zh: 我们首先将多智能体仅 PIU 条件与加入原始私有源材料的条件进行比较。

sents.en: In both conditions, participants receive their assigned PIUs explicitly as facts relevant to the decision; in Multi-Agent Full-Context, they must instead retrieve those facts from the source material.
sents.zh: 在两种条件下，参与者都会以与决策相关的事实的明确形式收到其被分配的 PIU；而在多智能体全上下文中，他们必须改为从源材料中检索这些事实。

sents.en: This comparison tests whether adding source material changes the interaction even when the relevant facts are already supplied directly.
sents.zh: 这一比较检验的是，在相关事实已被直接提供的情况下，加入源材料是否会改变交互作用。

sents.en: In Multi-Agent PIU-Only, the advantage of Simultaneous responses over Coordinator-selected speaker is 10.6 percentage points larger under All-but-one PIU concentration than under One PIU per participant.
sents.zh: 在多智能体仅 PIU 条件下，「同时回答」相对于「协调者选定发言者」的优势在「除一人外均有 PIU」集中方式下比在「每名参与者一个 PIU」下大 10.6 个百分点。

sents.en: Adding source material changes this interaction to − 5.1 -5.1 points, a statistically significant change of − 15.7 -15.7 points.
sents.zh: 加入源材料使这一交互作用变为 −5.1 分，即发生了 −15.7 分的统计上显著的变化。

paragraphs.en: To locate the loss, we next independently vary source-material access for participants assigned PIUs and those assigned no PIU, holding exact PIUs and public descriptions fixed. Under All-but-one PIU concentration and Simultaneous responses, source material only for participants assigned no PIU reduces episode success from 69.7% to 22.5%; source material only for participants assigned PIUs reduces it to 54.8%. The larger loss thus occurs without changing the latter group’s inputs. However, source placement changes both participant processing and messages, so it does not isolate their effect on the final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 为了定位损失来源，我们接下来独立改变被分配 PIU 的参与者和未被分配 PIU 的参与者获取源材料的机会，同时保持确切的 PIU 和公开描述不变。 在「仅保留一个 PIU 的集中分配」和「同时响应」条件下，仅为未被分配 PIU 的参与者提供源材料会将片段成功率从 69.7% 降至 22.5%；仅为被分配 PIU 的参与者提供源材料则将其降至 54.8%。 因此，更大的损失发生在不改变后者组输入的情况下。 然而，源材料放置位置会同时改变参与者的处理过程和消息内容，因此它无法分离出二者对最终决策的影响。

sents.en: To locate the loss, we next independently vary source-material access for participants assigned PIUs and those assigned no PIU, holding exact PIUs and public descriptions fixed.
sents.zh: 为了定位损失来源，我们接下来独立改变被分配 PIU 的参与者和未被分配 PIU 的参与者获取源材料的机会，同时保持确切的 PIU 和公开描述不变。

sents.en: Under All-but-one PIU concentration and Simultaneous responses, source material only for participants assigned no PIU reduces episode success from 69.7% to 22.5%; source material only for participants assigned PIUs reduces it to 54.8%.
sents.zh: 在「仅保留一个 PIU 的集中分配」和「同时响应」条件下，仅为未被分配 PIU 的参与者提供源材料会将片段成功率从 69.7% 降至 22.5%；仅为被分配 PIU 的参与者提供源材料则将其降至 54.8%。

sents.en: The larger loss thus occurs without changing the latter group’s inputs.
sents.zh: 因此，更大的损失发生在不改变后者组输入的情况下。

sents.en: However, source placement changes both participant processing and messages, so it does not isolate their effect on the final decision.
sents.zh: 然而，源材料放置位置会同时改变参与者的处理过程和消息内容，因此它无法分离出二者对最终决策的影响。

paragraphs.en: If messages from participants assigned no PIU cause the loss, removing them should selectively improve success when their authors received source material. We therefore freeze all participant messages and regenerate only the final decision, comparing the complete transcript with one retaining only messages from participants assigned PIUs. Both transcript conditions regenerate the final decision, so the complete-transcript success rates differ slightly from those above. Table 5 reports this test. Table 5 : Fixed-message intervention. Episode success rates under All-but-one PIU concentration and Simultaneous responses. Rows vary private source material for participants assigned no PIU; participants assigned PIUs receive no source material in either row. Effects are the change from removing messages, in pp. The interaction is the removal effect with source material minus that without it. Yellow cells and ∗ mark statistically significant effects. Source material Complete transcript Messages from participants assigned no PIU removed Effect (pp) Absent 69.9% 68.9% − 1.0 -1.0 Present 21.2% 68.9% + 47.7 ∗ +47.7^{*} Interaction + 48.7 ∗ +48.7^{*} Messages from participants assigned no PIU can impair the final decision, even when the evidence communicated by participants assigned PIUs is retained. Removing those messages improves success when their authors receive source material, with no statistically significant improvement when they do not. The interaction between source-material access and message removal is statistically significant. The result identifies a harmful contribution at the final-decision stage; it does not distinguish transcript length from distracting or contradictory content. Appendix E.7.3 – E.7.4 reports the complete design, uncertainty estimates, and scope.
paragraphs.zh: 如果来自未被分配 PIU 的参与者的消息造成了损失，那么当这些消息的作者获得了源材料时，删除这些消息应当能选择性地提升成功率。 因此我们冻结所有参与者的消息，仅重新生成最终决策，将完整对话记录与仅保留被分配 PIU 的参与者消息的对话记录进行比较。 两种对话记录条件下都重新生成最终决策，因此完整对话记录的成功率与上文略有不同。 表 5 报告了这一检验。 表 5：固定消息干预。 在「除一个 PIU 外全部集中分配」与「同时响应」两种条件下的回合成功率。 各行对未被分配 PIU 的参与者的私有源材料进行变化；被分配 PIU 的参与者在两行中均不获得源材料。 效应为删除消息带来的变化，单位为百分点（pp）。 交互项为有源材料时的删除效应减去无源材料时的删除效应。 黄色单元格和 ∗ 标记统计上显著的效果。 源材料 完整对话记录 删除未被分配 PIU 的参与者的消息后的效果（pp） 无 69.9% 68.9% − 1.0 -1.0 有 21.2% 68.9% + 47.7 ∗ +47.7^{*} 交互项 + 48.7 ∗ +48.7^{*} 未被分配 PIU 的参与者的消息可能损害最终决策，即使被分配 PIU 的参与者所传达的证据得以保留。 当这些消息的作者获得源材料时，删除这些消息能提升成功率；当他们未获得源材料时，提升在统计上不显著。 源材料获取与消息删除之间的交互效应在统计上显著。 该结果识别了最终决策阶段的有害贡献；它并未区分对话记录长度与分散注意力或矛盾的内容。 附录 E.7.3 – E.7.4 报告了完整的设计、不确定性估计和适用范围。

sents.en: If messages from participants assigned no PIU cause the loss, removing them should selectively improve success when their authors received source material.
sents.zh: 如果来自未被分配 PIU 的参与者的消息造成了损失，那么当这些消息的作者获得了源材料时，删除这些消息应当能选择性地提升成功率。

sents.en: Removing those messages improves success when their authors receive source material, with no statistically significant improvement when they do not.
sents.zh: 当这些消息的作者获得源材料时，删除这些消息能提升成功率；当他们未获得源材料时，提升在统计上不显著。

sents.en: The interaction between source-material access and message removal is statistically significant.
sents.zh: 源材料获取与消息删除之间的交互效应在统计上显著。

sents.en: The result identifies a harmful contribution at the final-decision stage; it does not distinguish transcript length from distracting or contradictory content.
sents.zh: 该结果识别了最终决策阶段的有害贡献；它并未区分对话记录长度与分散注意力或矛盾的内容。

sents.en: Appendix E.7.3 – E.7.4 reports the complete design, uncertainty estimates, and scope.
sents.zh: 附录 E.7.3 – E.7.4 报告了完整的设计、不确定性估计和适用范围。

paragraphs.en: Under Multi-Agent Full-Context with One PIU per participant and Coordinator-selected speaker, we vary private-note, message, and local-transcript token budgets, which respectively limit unshared notes, messages, and newly available transcript text. Among them, the message budget has the strongest relationship with episode success rate: for GPT-5.5 on 24 CUAD and 29 Multi-LexSum instances, increasing it from 32 to 128 tokens raises the rate from 55.3% to 78.6%, averaged over private-note budgets, with no further gain at 256 tokens; private-note differences are smaller, and larger local-transcript budgets show no consistent improvement on Multi-LexSum. Appendix E.8 reports complete results and diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 在多智能体全上下文（每个参与者一个 PIU，由协调者选择发言者）的设置下，我们改变私人笔记、消息和本地转录的 token 预算，它们分别限制未共享的笔记、消息以及新可用的转录文本。 其中，消息预算与回合成功率的关联最强：对于 GPT-5.5 在 24 个 CUAD 实例和 29 个 Multi-LexSum 实例上的表现，将其从 32 提高到 128 tokens，可使成功率从 55.3% 升至 78.6%（在私人笔记预算上取平均），而在 256 tokens 时不再有进一步提升；私人笔记的差异较小，而更大的本地转录预算在 Multi-LexSum 上未显示出一致的改进。 附录 E.8 报告了完整结果和诊断信息。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate policy training with TeamGym under two communication structures: (1) Coordinator-selected speaker, where we train participant and coordinator policies and the coordinator selects and queries participants and makes the final decision; and (2) Current-speaker selection, where we train a shared participant policy and each current speaker either selects the next participant or ends communication. For this demonstration, the participant that ends communication makes the final decision, so no separate final decision maker is used. All policies are initialized from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . In both demonstrations, the LLM-judged score assigned by GPT-5.5 serves as training reward. We call systematic changes in participation, speaker selection, and communication emergent coordination when these behaviors are not specified as separate rewards or training targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种通信结构下使用 TeamGym 展示策略训练：(1) 协调者选择发言者，即我们训练参与者与协调者策略，由协调者选择并询问参与者并做出最终决策；(2) 当前发言者选择，即我们训练一个共享的参与者策略，由每位当前发言者选择下一位参与者或结束通信。 在此演示中，结束通信的参与者做出最终决策，因此不使用单独的最终决策者。 所有策略均由 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Yang et al., 2024）初始化，并使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）（Shao et al., 2024）进行训练。 在两个演示中，由 GPT-5.5 给出的 LLM 评审分数作为训练奖励。 当参与、发言者选择和通信中的系统性变化并未被指定为单独的奖励或训练目标时，我们将这些行为称为涌现协调。

sents.zh: 当参与、发言者选择和通信中的系统性变化并未被指定为单独的奖励或训练目标时，我们将这些行为称为涌现协调。

paragraphs.en: Under Coordinator-selected speaker, a shared participant policy generates messages from source material, while a coordinator policy generates queries and the final decision. We use Multi-Agent Full-Context on CUAD- and MAUD-derived problem instances ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023b ) , converting each decision task to a free-form written decision format while preserving its PIU distribution and source material (Appendix G.1.1 ). Training and checkpoint selection use only CUAD-derived problem instances; the 26 MAUD-derived problem instances evaluate transfer. We compare (1) two-stage policy training, which updates the participant and coordinator policies successively to examine which behaviors change when each policy is updated separately, and (2) joint two-policy training, which allows them to co-adapt and serves as the primary end-to-end experiment. Appendices G.1.2 and G.2 provide evaluation, optimization, and checkpoint-selection details.
paragraphs.zh: 在由协调者选择发言者的机制下，一个共享的参与者策略根据源材料生成消息，而协调者策略生成查询并做出最终决策。 我们在源自 CUAD 和 MAUD 的问题实例上使用多智能体全上下文方法（Hendrycks et al., 2021；Wang et al., 2023b），将每个决策任务转换为自由格式的书面决策形式，同时保留其 PIU 分布和源材料（附录 G.1.1）。 训练和检查点选择仅使用源自 CUAD 的问题实例；26 个源自 MAUD 的问题实例用于评估迁移能力。 我们比较了两种方法：（1）两阶段策略训练，即依次更新参与者策略和协调者策略，以考察分别更新各策略时哪些行为会发生变化；（2）双策略联合训练，允许二者共同适应，并作为主要的端到端实验。 附录 G.1.2 和 G.2 提供了评估、优化和检查点选择的细节。

paragraphs.en: On the 36 CUAD-derived validation instances, the LLM-judged score increases from 12.14% to 16.84% after the participant-only stage and to 23.33% after the coordinator-only continuation. Illustrative examples show that the participant-only stage changes which PIUs appear in participant messages and, through the resulting transcript, can change queries generated by the fixed coordinator policy; the coordinator-only continuation can change queries and final decisions even when participant messages remain substantively unchanged. Two-stage policy training can therefore change participant messages, coordinator queries, and final decisions, but its CUAD-derived validation gains do not transfer to the 26 held-out MAUD-derived problem instances. Appendix G.2.2 provides training details and illustrative examples.
paragraphs.zh: 在 36 个由 CUAD 衍生的验证实例上，LLM 评审的得分在仅参与智能体阶段后从 12.14% 提升至 16.84%，在仅协调智能体的延续阶段后进一步提升至 23.33%。 示例表明，仅参与智能体阶段会改变参与智能体消息中出现的 PIU，并通过由此产生的对话记录改变固定的协调智能体策略所生成的查询；即使参与智能体的消息在实质上保持不变，仅协调智能体的延续阶段也可能改变查询和最终决策。 因此，两阶段策略训练可以改变参与智能体的消息、协调智能体的查询和最终决策，但其在 CUAD 衍生验证集上的收益无法迁移到 26 个留出的由 MAUD 衍生的问题实例上。 附录 G.2.2 提供了训练细节和示例。

paragraphs.en: Joint two-policy training produces short coordinator queries and queries every participant, despite not directly rewarding either behavior. On the 36 CUAD-derived validation problem instances, joint two-policy training increases the LLM-judged score from 11.97% to 22.38% and the share of problem instances in which the coordinator queries every participant from 80.6% to 100%. Because querying every participant does not enter the training reward, this increase is an instance of emergent coordination. Table 6 shows distinct coordinator-query behavior: joint two-policy training uses shorter queries, queries every participant, and never copies the problem question in the first query, whereas two-stage policy training uses longer queries and more later queries that reuse terms from preceding participant replies. Figure 7 (a) reports the scheduled validation trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 联合双策略训练会产生较短的协调者查询，并查询每一位参与者，尽管这两种行为都没有被直接奖励。 在 36 个基于 CUAD 派生的验证问题实例上，联合双策略训练将 LLM 评审得分从 11.97% 提升到 22.38%，并将协调者查询每一位参与者的问题实例占比从 80.6% 提升到 100%。 由于查询每一位参与者并不计入训练奖励，这一提升是涌现式协调的一个实例。 表 6 展示了不同的协调者查询行为：联合双策略训练使用更短的查询、查询每一位参与者，并且在第一次查询中从不照搬问题原文，而两阶段策略训练则使用更长的查询，并且有更多复用前述参与者回复中术语的后续查询。 图 7 (a) 报告了计划中的验证轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Joint two-policy training produces short queries, does not copy the problem question in the first query, and queries every participant on all 36 problem instances. Later queries that reuse terms from preceding participant replies remain infrequent, so the learned coordinator-query behavior is characterized primarily by shorter queries and querying every participant.
paragraphs.zh: 联合双策略训练产生了较短的查询，第一个查询不复述问题中的问题，并在全部 36 个问题实例上查询每个参与者。 后续查询中复用先前参与者回复中术语的情况仍然少见，因此学到的协调者查询行为主要表现为更短的查询以及查询每个参与者。

sents.en: Joint two-policy training produces short queries, does not copy the problem question in the first query, and queries every participant on all 36 problem instances.
sents.zh: 联合双策略训练产生了较短的查询，第一个查询不复述问题中的问题，并在全部 36 个问题实例上查询每个参与者。

sents.en: Later queries that reuse terms from preceding participant replies remain infrequent, so the learned coordinator-query behavior is characterized primarily by shorter queries and querying every participant.

paragraphs.en: On 26 MAUD-derived instances, under joint two-policy training the coordinator queries every participant and every participant sends a public message in all 26, versus 20 under the base policies, while the aggregate LLM-judged score changes only from 5.12% to 5.58%. Thus, coordination behavior transfers even when final-decision quality changes little. Appendix G.2.3 provides training details, an example, and additional analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 在 26 个由 MAUD 派生的实例上，在双策略联合训练下，协调者在全部 26 个实例中都询问每位参与者，且每位参与者在全部 26 个实例中都发送公开消息，而基础策略下为 20 个；与此同时，LLM 评判的总体得分仅从 5.12% 变为 5.58%。 因此，即使最终决策质量变化不大，协调行为仍能迁移。 附录 G.2.3 提供了训练细节、一个示例以及更多分析。

paragraphs.en: We train a shared participant policy under Current-speaker selection in Multi-Agent PIU-Only with One PIU per participant. The shared policy controls participant messages, next-participant selection, decisions to end communication, and the final decision. Public participant descriptions are visible to support participant selection. Training uses 350 FinDVer problem instances and 188 two- or three-participant FinLongDocQA problem instances. We select the checkpoint using the 39-instance FinDVer validation subset and report separate evaluations on the 21-instance FinLongDocQA validation subset and 40 held-out four-participant FinLongDocQA problem instances. The held-out test comparison therefore asks whether a policy trained on two- and three-participant FinLongDocQA problem instances also improves performance on four-participant instances. The trained shared participant policy improves LLM-judged scores on both validation subsets and on held-out four-participant FinLongDocQA problem instances. Figure 7 (b) and Table 7 report the results. Appendix G.3 provides the data-split, optimization, checkpoint-selection, and diagnostic details.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在“当前发言者选择”设置下的“多智能体仅PIU（每名参与者一个PIU）”中训练一个共享的参与者策略。 该共享策略控制参与者消息、下一位参与者的选择、结束交流的决策以及最终决策。 公开的参与者描述可见，以支持参与者选择。 训练使用350个FinDVer问题实例和188个双或三参与者的FinLongDocQA问题实例。 我们使用39个实例的FinDVer验证子集来选择检查点，并分别在21个实例的FinLongDocQA验证子集和40个留出的四参与者FinLongDocQA问题实例上进行单独评估。 因此，留出测试的比较所探究的是：在双和三参与者FinLongDocQA问题实例上训练的策略是否也能提升四参与者实例上的表现。 经过训练的共享参与者策略在两个验证子集以及留出的四参与者FinLongDocQA问题实例上都提升了LLM评审的分数。 图7 (b) 和表7报告了结果。 附录G.3提供了数据划分、优化、检查点选择和诊断的详细内容。

sents.en: We train a shared participant policy under Current-speaker selection in Multi-Agent PIU-Only with One PIU per participant.

sents.en: We select the checkpoint using the 39-instance FinDVer validation subset and report separate evaluations on the 21-instance FinLongDocQA validation subset and 40 held-out four-participant FinLongDocQA problem instances.
sents.zh: 我们使用39个实例的FinDVer验证子集来选择检查点，并分别在21个实例的FinLongDocQA验证子集和40个留出的四参与者FinLongDocQA问题实例上进行单独评估。

sents.en: The held-out test comparison therefore asks whether a policy trained on two- and three-participant FinLongDocQA problem instances also improves performance on four-participant instances.

paragraphs.en: Here, a communication trajectory comprises the communication transcript, next-participant selections, the decision to end communication, and the identity and assigned PIU of the participant making the final decision. The final-decision policy is the base or trained shared participant policy used only to regenerate the final decision. Cross-replay holds this trajectory and the final-decision prompt fixed while varying the final-decision policy. Across these 40 problem instances, replacing the base communication trajectory with the trained trajectory, averaged across the two final-decision policies, yields a 6.95-point gain. Replacing the base final-decision policy with the trained policy does not produce a statistically significant improvement. Thus, within cross-replay, the validation gain is concentrated in the communication trajectory rather than the final-decision policy. Training also increases the proportion of participants who send public messages and the number of distinct speakers while reducing the rate at which a speaker selects itself as the next participant on validation and test. Because these diagnostics do not enter the reward, the changes provide evidence of emergent coordination in participation and next-participant selection.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，通信轨迹包括通信记录文本、下一参与者选择、结束通信的决策，以及做出最终决策的参与者的身份和所分配的 PIU。 最终决策策略是基础或训练后的共享参与者策略，仅用于重新生成最终决策。 交叉重放（cross-replay）在固定该轨迹和最终决策提示的同时，变换最终决策策略。 在这 40 个问题实例上，用训练后的轨迹替换基础通信轨迹，并在两种最终决策策略上取平均，可带来 6.95 分的提升。 用训练后的策略替换基础最终决策策略并未带来统计上显著的改进。 因此，在交叉重放中，验证提升集中于通信轨迹而非最终决策策略。 训练还提高了发送公开消息的参与者比例以及不同发言者的数量，同时降低了在验证和测试中发言者将自己选为下一参与者的频率。 由于这些诊断指标并不进入奖励，这些变化为参与和下一参与者选择中涌现的协调提供了证据。

paragraphs.en: To test whether additional public messages make more PIUs available for the final decision, we apply the same GPT-5.5 final-decision policy to every base and trained communication transcript. Unlike cross-replay, this analysis retains every trajectory, including valid public messages produced before an episode that does not reach a final decision. On FinDVer, trained transcripts improve performance under the same final-decision policy by 12.6 points and increase the proportion of PIUs appearing in the transcript by 15.9 points. On held-out FinLongDocQA, however, end-to-end score and final-decision completion improve, but the changes in performance under the same final-decision policy and in the proportion of PIUs appearing in the transcript are not statistically distinguishable from zero. Together, these results show that broader participation and higher end-to-end performance do not necessarily coincide with a larger proportion of PIUs appearing in the communication transcript. Table 10 reports these comparisons, and Appendix G.3.5 reports additional diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验额外的公开消息是否能让更多 PIU 可用于最终决策，我们对每一条基础与训练后的通信记录应用相同的 GPT-5.5 最终决策策略。 与跨回放不同，本分析保留了每一条轨迹，包括在未达成最终决策的回合之前产生的有效公开消息。 在 FinDVer 上，在相同的最终决策策略下，训练后的通信记录使性能提升 12.6 分，并使 PIU 出现在通信记录中的比例提高 15.9 分。 然而，在留出的 FinLongDocQA 上，端到端分数和最终决策完成率有所改善，但在相同最终决策策略下的性能变化以及 PIU 出现在通信记录中的比例变化在统计上与零无法区分。 综合来看，这些结果表明，更广泛的参与和更高的端到端性能并不必然伴随更大比例的 PIU 出现在通信记录中。 表 10 报告了这些比较，附录 G.3.5 报告了额外的诊断结果。

paragraphs.en: Across both fixed communication structures, training changes unrewarded coordination behaviors as well as final-decision quality. Under Coordinator-selected speaker, the participant and coordinator policies change participant messages, coordinator queries, and final decisions; under Current-speaker selection, the shared participant policy changes participation, next-participant selection, and the communication trajectory. Each demonstration reports one training run; results across additional runs and base models remain to be evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种固定通信结构下，训练不仅改变最终决策质量，也改变未受奖励的协调行为。 在由协调者选择发言者的结构下，参与者和协调者的策略会改变参与者的消息、协调者的提问以及最终决策；在当前发言者选择的结构下，共享的参与者策略会改变参与行为、下一位参与者的选择以及通信轨迹。 每个演示报告一次训练运行的结果；在更多运行和更多基础模型上的结果仍有待评估。

paragraphs.en: Human-AI decision making motivates evaluating AI systems as team participants and examining the interaction process rather than only the final decision ( Lai et al., 2021 ; Herath Pathirannehelage et al., 2025 ; Seeber et al., 2020 ) . Hidden-profile studies show that human teams can fail to reveal uniquely held information, and collective-intelligence research relates interaction structure to performance ( Stasser and Titus, 1985 ; Woolley et al., 2010 ) . Work on limited attention, working memory, and information overload motivates finite resource constraints ( Kahneman, 1973 ; Cowan, 2001 ; Eppler and Mengis, 2004 ) . These findings motivate our controlled comparisons, but TeamGym does not evaluate human-AI teams or treat its token budgets as models of human cognition. Work using LLMs to simulate social settings has a different objective: plausible social behavior is the object of study, whereas TeamGym treats the participant model as a controlled component ( Park et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2023 ; Hansen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人机决策研究促使我们将智能体系统评估为团队参与者，并考察交互过程而非仅看最终决策（Lai et al., 2021；Herath Pathirannehelage et al., 2025；Seeber et al., 2020）。 隐藏档案研究表明，人类团队可能无法揭示各自独占的信息，而群体智能研究则将交互结构与绩效联系起来（Stasser and Titus, 1985；Woolley et al., 2010）。 关于有限注意力、工作记忆和信息过载的研究为有限资源约束提供了依据（Kahneman, 1973；Cowan, 2001；Eppler and Mengis, 2004）。 这些发现促成了我们的受控比较，但 TeamGym 并不评估人机团队，也未将其 token 预算作为人类认知的模型。 使用大语言模型模拟社会环境的研究有不同的目标：可信的社会行为本身是研究对象，而 TeamGym 将参与者模型视为受控组件（Park et al., 2022；Park et al., 2023；Hansen et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: CAMEL, AutoGen, MetaGPT, and ChatDev study collaboration through prompted agent interaction ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . PEER learns collaborative writing, MDAgents studies adaptive medical collaboration, and other work studies debate and collaborative post-training ( Schick et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2025 ) . CooperBench evaluates cooperative coding over repositories ( Khatua et al., 2026 ) . These systems study agent coordination, but TeamGym fixes source-grounded PIUs, controls the PIU distribution and whether participants receive PIUs directly or source material containing them, and measures whether bounded communication makes the PIUs available for a final decision. Multi-agent debate commonly gives agents the same problem; TeamGym gives participants different initial local observations.
paragraphs.zh: CAMEL、AutoGen、MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 通过提示驱动的智能体交互研究协作（Li et al., 2023；Wu et al., 2023；Hong et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2024）。 PEER 研究协作写作，MDAgents 研究自适应的医疗协作，其他工作则研究辩论与协作后训练（Schick et al., 2023；Kim et al., 2024；Du et al., 2024；Park et al., 2025）。 CooperBench 在代码仓库上评估协作式编程（Khatua et al., 2026）。 这些系统研究智能体协调，而 TeamGym 固定基于源材料的 PIU，控制 PIU 的分布以及参与者是直接获得 PIU 还是获得包含它们的源材料，并衡量受限通信能否使这些 PIU 可用于最终决策。 多智能体辩论通常给智能体相同的问题；TeamGym 则给参与者不同的初始局部观察。

paragraphs.en: MultiAgentBench evaluates coordination under several communication topologies ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . HiddenBench evaluates whether teams surface and combine directly presented hidden facts ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , while SILO-BENCH studies role-free collaboration on synthetic distributed-computation problems ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Appendix B gives compact comparisons with both benchmarks. Collaborative Gym studies a user or user simulator collaborating with one LLM agent, while our unit of analysis is a team with decision-relevant evidence divided among participants ( Shao et al., 2026 ) . Single-agent suites such as SmartPlay and AgentBench do not require recovery of evidence held by teammates ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: MultiAgentBench 在多种通信拓扑下评估协调能力（Zhu et al., 2025）。 HiddenBench 评估团队能否发现并整合直接呈现的隐藏事实（Li et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026），而 SILO-BENCH 研究在合成的分布式计算问题上的无角色协作（Zhang et al., 2026）。 附录 B 给出了与这两个基准的简要对比。 Collaborative Gym 研究用户或用户模拟器与单个 LLM 智能体的协作，而我们的分析单位是一个团队，其中与决策相关的证据分散在参与者之间（Shao et al., 2026）。 诸如 SmartPlay 和 AgentBench 之类的单智能体测试套件不需要恢复队友所掌握的证据（Wu et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024）。

sents.en: MultiAgentBench evaluates coordination under several communication topologies ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: MultiAgentBench 在多种通信拓扑下评估协调能力（Zhu et al., 2025）。

sents.en: HiddenBench evaluates whether teams surface and combine directly presented hidden facts ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , while SILO-BENCH studies role-free collaboration on synthetic distributed-computation problems ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: HiddenBench 评估团队能否发现并整合直接呈现的隐藏事实（Li et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026），而 SILO-BENCH 研究在合成的分布式计算问题上的无角色协作（Zhang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Appendix B gives compact comparisons with both benchmarks.
sents.zh: 附录 B 给出了与这两个基准的简要对比。

sents.en: Collaborative Gym studies a user or user simulator collaborating with one LLM agent, while our unit of analysis is a team with decision-relevant evidence divided among participants ( Shao et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Collaborative Gym 研究用户或用户模拟器与单个 LLM 智能体的协作，而我们的分析单位是一个团队，其中与决策相关的证据分散在参与者之间（Shao et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Single-agent suites such as SmartPlay and AgentBench do not require recovery of evidence held by teammates ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: We introduce TeamGym , a gym for constructing team decision problem instances and for evaluating and training participant and coordinator policies under controlled PIU distributions, communication structures, and token budgets. Across 8 language models and 12 source corpora, distributing the same PIUs across participants reduces episode success rate by 22.9 percentage points relative to providing them to a single model, and requiring participants to retrieve those PIUs from source material reduces it by a further 19.9 points. The effectiveness of a communication structure also varies across PIU-distribution conditions. Team decision-making therefore depends not only on individual model capabilities, but also on how participants retrieve, communicate, and integrate distributed information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TeamGym，一个用于构建团队决策问题实例，并在受控的 PIU 分布、通信结构和 token 预算下评估与训练参与者及协调者策略的 gym。 在 8 个语言模型和 12 个源语料库上，将相同的 PIU 分发给多个参与者相比将其提供给单个模型，会使回合成功率降低 22.9 个百分点，而要求参与者从源材料中检索这些 PIU 则会使其进一步降低 19.9 个百分点。 通信结构的有效性也随 PIU 分布条件而变化。 因此，团队决策不仅取决于单个模型的能力，还取决于参与者如何检索、沟通和整合分布式信息。

sents.zh: 因此，团队决策不仅取决于单个模型的能力，还取决于参与者如何检索、沟通和整合分布式信息。

paragraphs.en: Across two fixed communication structures, policy training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication. With coordinator control, joint two-policy training produces a compact information-elicitation protocol; without a coordinator, training improves end-to-end final-decision quality and completion while increasing participation. Tracing PIUs through these trajectories shows that increased participation makes more pivotal information available on FinDVer validation, but not on held-out FinLongDocQA. This distinction illustrates how TeamGym diagnoses how training changes team decision making, rather than reporting only whether performance improves.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种固定的通信结构下，策略训练都能提升最终决策质量，并在参与、发言者选择和沟通方面诱导出涌现的协调行为。 在有协调者控制时，两个策略的联合训练会产生一种紧凑的信息引出协议；在没有协调者时，训练能提升端到端的最终决策质量和完成度，同时增加参与度。 追踪这些轨迹中的关键信息单元（PIU）表明，参与度的提高使更多关键信息在 FinDVer 验证集上变得可用，但在留出的 FinLongDocQA 上并非如此。 这一区别说明 TeamGym 能够诊断训练如何改变团队决策，而不仅仅是报告性能是否提升。

paragraphs.en: These training demonstrations use one run each, and the improvements under Coordinator-selected speaker are measured on CUAD-derived validation problem instances used for checkpoint selection. On MAUD-derived problem instances, the learned query and messaging patterns transfer more clearly than final-decision quality. Extensions of TeamGym could relax the shared-payoff assumption to study strategic information transmission, malicious or unreliable participants, and teams with partially aligned objectives. They could also introduce explicit retrieval costs and allow participants to choose which source material to retrieve. By separating retrieval, communication, and final decisions while holding the underlying problem fixed, TeamGym provides a controlled foundation for diagnosing and training team decision-making capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 这些训练演示各使用一次运行，而在协调者所选发言者机制下取得的改进，是在基于 CUAD 派生、用于检查点选择的验证问题上测得的。 在基于 MAUD 派生的问题实例上，学习到的查询与消息传递模式比最终决策质量迁移得更明显。 TeamGym 的扩展可以放宽共享收益假设，以研究策略性信息传递、恶意或不可靠的参与者，以及目标部分一致的团队。 这些扩展还可以引入显式的检索成本，并允许参与者选择检索哪些原始材料。 通过在保持底层问题不变的情况下将检索、沟通与最终决策分离，TeamGym 为诊断和训练团队决策能力提供了一个可控的基础。

paragraphs.en: HiddenBench is the closest benchmark to TeamGym because both study team decisions under decentralized information structures. HiddenBench provides broad coverage of Hidden Profile settings (Version 4 evaluates 65 problem instances and 15 models) and examines whether directly presented participant-specific facts enter public discussion and improve group voting ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . TeamGym complements this breadth by treating the source-grounded information and interaction environment as controlled experimental variables: it varies PIU distribution, whether participants receive PIUs directly or source material containing them, communication structure, and token budgets while holding the underlying problem and evidence requirements fixed. Paired contrasts and PIU-distribution–communication-structure regressions quantify how performance changes across these conditions, while PIU-level process tracing localizes plausible stages at which required evidence is lost. TeamGym additionally supports a participant-only stage, a coordinator-only continuation, and joint two-policy training under Coordinator-selected speaker, together with training of a shared participant policy under Current-speaker selection, with the participant that ends communication making the final decision. Thus, HiddenBench provides a broader Hidden Profile evaluation, whereas TeamGym provides a more controlled, source-grounded environment for studying how PIU distribution and communication structure jointly relate to team performance.
paragraphs.zh: HiddenBench 是与 TeamGym 最接近的基准，因为两者都研究去中心化信息结构下的团队决策。 HiddenBench 广泛覆盖隐藏档案（Hidden Profile）设定（Version 4 评估 65 个问题实例和 15 个模型），并考察直接呈现的参与者特定事实是否进入公开讨论并改善群体投票（ Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ）。 TeamGym 通过将有依据的信息来源和交互环境作为受控实验变量来补充这种广度：它在保持底层问题和证据要求不变的情况下，改变 PIU 分布、参与者是直接接收 PIU 还是接收包含 PIU 的原始材料、通信结构以及 token 预算。 成对对比以及 PIU 分布与通信结构的回归分析量化了性能在这些条件下如何变化，而 PIU 层面的过程追踪则定位出所需证据可能丢失的阶段。 TeamGym 还支持仅参与者阶段、仅协调者的延续阶段，以及在协调者选择发言者机制下的双策略联合训练，同时支持在当前发言者选择机制下训练共享的参与者策略，由结束通信的参与者做出最终决策。 因此，HiddenBench 提供了更广泛的隐藏档案评估，而 TeamGym 提供了一个更受控、有信息来源依据的环境，用于研究 PIU 分布和通信结构如何共同影响团队表现。

paragraphs.en: SILO-BENCH studies role-free agents solving synthetic distributed-computation problems under direct-message, broadcast, and shared-file protocols, with programmatically known answers and weak-scaling evaluations from 2 to 100 agents ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . This design is particularly useful for examining how emergent organization, consensus, and communication cost change as both team size and the global problem grow. TeamGym instead holds each real-world decision problem and its evidence requirements fixed while varying PIU distribution, whether participants receive PIUs directly or source material containing them, communication structure, and token budgets. Its communication gap compares Single-Agent All-PIU with Multi-Agent PIU-Only, while its retrieval gap compares Multi-Agent PIU-Only with Multi-Agent Full-Context. These outcome-based contrasts are distinct from SILO-BENCH’s log-based Communication-Reasoning Gap. TeamGym also supports a participant-only stage, a coordinator-only continuation, and joint two-policy training under Coordinator-selected speaker, together with training of a shared participant policy under Current-speaker selection, with the participant that ends communication making the final decision. Consequently, SILO-BENCH characterizes how emergent collaboration behaves under weak scaling, whereas TeamGym more directly examines how controlled PIU distributions and communication structures relate to performance on fixed, source-grounded team decisions.
paragraphs.zh: SILO-BENCH 研究无角色设定的智能体在直接消息、广播和共享文件协议下求解合成分布式计算问题，答案可通过程序化方式获得，并提供从 2 到 100 个智能体的弱扩展性评估（Zhang et al., 2026）。 这一设计对于考察随着团队规模和全局问题的增长，涌现出的组织、共识与通信成本如何变化尤为有用。 TeamGym 则保持每个真实世界决策问题及其证据需求固定不变，同时变化 PIU 分布（参与者是直接接收 PIU 还是接收包含 PIU 的原始材料）、通信结构以及 token 预算。 其通信差距比较的是「单智能体全 PIU」与「多智能体仅 PIU」，而其检索差距比较的是「多智能体仅 PIU」与「多智能体全上下文」。 这些基于结果的对比有别于 SILO-BENCH 基于日志的「通信-推理差距」。 TeamGym 还支持仅参与者阶段、仅协调者的延续训练，以及在协调者选择发言者下的双策略联合训练，同时也支持在当前发言者选择机制下训练共享的参与者策略，由结束通信的参与者做出最终决策。 因此，SILO-BENCH 刻画的是涌现协作在弱扩展性下的表现，而 TeamGym 更直接地考察受控的 PIU 分布与通信结构如何与固定且基于原始来源的团队决策表现相关联。

paragraphs.en: At each communication round, the environment constructs the current observation permitted by the communication structure and resource budgets. The applicable participant or coordinator policy receives this observation and generates an action permitted for its role, such as a participant message, coordinator query and speaker selection, or final decision. The implementation uses role-specific prompt templates and structured output schemas, parses the returned action, and applies structure-specific fallback rules. Model and decoding settings are reported with the corresponding evaluation or training setup. Under Current-speaker selection, an omitted or invalid next-participant selection defaults to the next participant in the fixed cyclic order.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个通信轮次中，环境根据通信结构和资源预算构建当前允许的观测。 适用的参与者或协调者策略接收该观测，并生成其角色所允许的动作，例如参与者消息、协调者查询与发言者选择，或最终决策。 实现采用角色特定的提示模板和结构化输出模式，解析返回的动作，并应用针对具体结构的回退规则。 模型与解码设置随相应的评估或训练设置一并报告。 在当前发言者选择机制下，若缺失或无效的下一位参与者选择，则默认选择固定循环顺序中的下一位参与者。

paragraphs.en: The three structures without coordinator control are related to public deliberation and multi-agent debate ( Gerardi and Yariv, 2007 ; Du et al., 2024 ) , whereas the two coordinator-controlled structures are related to mediated communication and fusion-center models ( Myerson, 1986 ; Forges, 1986 ; Varshney, 1997 ) . Their speaker-selection rules also draw on mechanisms studied in conversation analysis and multi-agent systems ( Sacks et al., 1974 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2019 ) . The five structures are not intended as an exhaustive taxonomy of communication structures.
paragraphs.zh: 这三种无协调者控制的结构与公开商议和多智能体辩论相关（Gerardi and Yariv, 2007；Du et al., 2024），而两种由协调者控制的结构则与中介化通信和融合中心模型相关（Myerson, 1986；Forges, 1986；Varshney, 1997）。 其发言者选择规则也借鉴了会话分析与多智能体系统中所研究的机制（Sacks et al., 1974；Wu et al., 2023；Kim et al., 2019）。 这五种结构并非旨在成为对通信结构的穷尽性分类。

paragraphs.en: Each problem instance is constructed from one or more source questions; the decision objective may retain one question or combine related questions. When a reference decision and the reasoning used to produce it accompany the source questions, we retain them. Otherwise, we construct the reference decision from the available source annotations and underlying source materials. When the reasoning is unavailable, we generate reasoning conditioned on the reference decision; answer-conditioned rationale generation provides one example of this procedure ( Wang et al., 2023a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 每个问题实例由一个或多个源问题构建；决策目标可以保留其中一个问题，也可以组合多个相关问题。 当参考决策及其生成该决策所用的推理过程随源问题一起给出时，我们将其保留。 否则，我们根据可用的源标注和底层源材料来构建参考决策。 当推理过程不可用时，我们以参考决策为条件生成推理过程；基于答案的理据生成就是这一流程的一个示例（Wang et al., 2023a）。

sents.en: When a reference decision and the reasoning used to produce it accompany the source questions, we retain them.
sents.zh: 当参考决策及其生成该决策所用的推理过程随源问题一起给出时，我们将其保留。
