paragraphs.en: SWE Atlas Codebase QnA asks for a source-grounded technical decision about a repository fixed at a recorded base commit. Construction loads the task question, positive and negative evaluation criteria, corpus-provided answer, Docker image, and base commit. The reference decision and evaluation criteria are used for hidden construction checks but are not shown to the agents that search the repository or receive the released evidence. Thirty-two of the 124 official entries pass the completed construction procedure and are retained.
paragraphs.zh: SWE Atlas Codebase QnA 要求针对一个固定在已记录基线提交（base commit）上的代码仓库，作出有来源依据的技术决策。 构建过程会加载任务问题、正向与负向评估标准、语料库提供的答案、Docker 镜像以及基线提交。 参考决策和评估标准用于隐藏的构建校验，但不会展示给搜索代码仓库或接收已发布证据的智能体。 124 个官方条目中有 32 个通过了完整的构建流程并被保留。

sents.en: SWE Atlas Codebase QnA asks for a source-grounded technical decision about a repository fixed at a recorded base commit.
sents.zh: SWE Atlas Codebase QnA 要求针对一个固定在已记录基线提交（base commit）上的代码仓库，作出有来源依据的技术决策。

sents.en: Construction loads the task question, positive and negative evaluation criteria, corpus-provided answer, Docker image, and base commit.
sents.zh: 构建过程会加载任务问题、正向与负向评估标准、语料库提供的答案、Docker 镜像以及基线提交。

sents.en: The reference decision and evaluation criteria are used for hidden construction checks but are not shown to the agents that search the repository or receive the released evidence.
sents.zh: 参考决策和评估标准用于隐藏的构建校验，但不会展示给搜索代码仓库或接收已发布证据的智能体。

sents.en: Thirty-two of the 124 official entries pass the completed construction procedure and are retained.
sents.zh: 124 个官方条目中有 32 个通过了完整的构建流程并被保留。

paragraphs.en: Construction collects exact source, test, configuration, documentation, and, when a criterion requires observed behavior, runtime evidence from the unchanged Docker checkout. Runtime commands use the installed repository tools, do not use the network or install packages, and record their output, exit status, commit, and repository state. A runtime observation is included only with the source or test evidence needed to interpret it; runtime output alone does not form a PIU.
paragraphs.zh: 构建过程从未更改的 Docker 检出中收集精确的源代码、测试、配置、文档证据，以及当某项准则需要观察到的行为时的运行时证据。 运行时命令使用仓库中已安装的工具，不使用网络或安装软件包，并记录其输出、退出状态、提交和仓库状态。 运行时观察只有在附带解读它所需的源代码或测试证据时才会被纳入；仅有运行时输出不构成 PIU。

sents.en: Construction collects exact source, test, configuration, documentation, and, when a criterion requires observed behavior, runtime evidence from the unchanged Docker checkout.
sents.zh: 构建过程从未更改的 Docker 检出中收集精确的源代码、测试、配置、文档证据，以及当某项准则需要观察到的行为时的运行时证据。

sents.en: Runtime commands use the installed repository tools, do not use the network or install packages, and record their output, exit status, commit, and repository state.
sents.zh: 运行时命令使用仓库中已安装的工具，不使用网络或安装软件包，并记录其输出、退出状态、提交和仓库状态。

sents.en: A runtime observation is included only with the source or test evidence needed to interpret it; runtime output alone does not form a PIU.
sents.zh: 运行时观察只有在附带解读它所需的源代码或测试证据时才会被纳入；仅有运行时输出不构成 PIU。

paragraphs.en: Candidate units are exact contiguous source-material spans that establish one answer contribution. Source, test, and runtime spans are grouped when they jointly establish one indivisible proposition; duplicates and fully contained contributions are merged, while independent contributions remain separate. Navigation results and model-written summaries are excluded. The construction does not target a fixed PIU count and retains at least two PIUs per collaborative problem instance.
paragraphs.zh: 候选单元是确立一个答案贡献的源材料中精确的连续片段。 当源片段、测试片段和运行时片段共同确立一个不可分割的命题时，它们会被分组；重复的以及被完全包含的贡献会被合并，而独立的贡献则保持分开。 导航结果和模型撰写的摘要被排除在外。 该构建不针对固定的 PIU 数量，并在每个协作问题实例中保留至少两个 PIU。

sents.en: Candidate units are exact contiguous source-material spans that establish one answer contribution.
sents.zh: 候选单元是确立一个答案贡献的源材料中精确的连续片段。

sents.en: Source, test, and runtime spans are grouped when they jointly establish one indivisible proposition; duplicates and fully contained contributions are merged, while independent contributions remain separate.
sents.zh: 当源片段、测试片段和运行时片段共同确立一个不可分割的命题时，它们会被分组；重复的以及被完全包含的贡献会被合并，而独立的贡献则保持分开。

sents.en: Navigation results and model-written summaries are excluded.
sents.zh: 导航结果和模型撰写的摘要被排除在外。

sents.en: The construction does not target a fixed PIU count and retains at least two PIUs per collaborative problem instance.
sents.zh: 该构建不针对固定的 PIU 数量，并在每个协作问题实例中保留至少两个 PIU。

paragraphs.en: Construction evaluates the complete candidate set, the decision objective with no candidate units, and each leave-one-out removal. The solver receives only the exact evidence available in the current check, while a separate judge assesses correctness and source grounding. A candidate is retained only when the complete set supports every required positive and negative criterion, the no-unit condition fails, and removing that candidate causes the linked answer component to fail. Candidate grouping or evidence collection is revised and the checks are repeated when these conditions do not hold.
paragraphs.zh: 构建阶段评估完整的候选集、无候选单元的决策目标，以及每次留一法移除。 求解器仅接收当前检查中可用的确切证据，而由单独的裁判评估正确性与来源依据。 只有当完整集合支持所有必需的肯定和否定准则、无单元条件不成立、且移除该候选会导致关联的答案组件失败时，该候选才会被保留。 当这些条件不满足时，将对候选分组或证据收集进行修订，并重复检查。

sents.en: Construction evaluates the complete candidate set, the decision objective with no candidate units, and each leave-one-out removal.
sents.zh: 构建阶段评估完整的候选集、无候选单元的决策目标，以及每次留一法移除。

sents.en: The solver receives only the exact evidence available in the current check, while a separate judge assesses correctness and source grounding.
sents.zh: 求解器仅接收当前检查中可用的确切证据，而由单独的裁判评估正确性与来源依据。

sents.en: A candidate is retained only when the complete set supports every required positive and negative criterion, the no-unit condition fails, and removing that candidate causes the linked answer component to fail.
sents.zh: 只有当完整集合支持所有必需的肯定和否定准则、无单元条件不成立、且移除该候选会导致关联的答案组件失败时，该候选才会被保留。

sents.en: Candidate grouping or evidence collection is revised and the checks are repeated when these conditions do not hold.
sents.zh: 当这些条件不满足时，将对候选分组或证据收集进行修订，并重复检查。

paragraphs.en: The evaluated distribution uses One PIU per participant. Source or test units and runtime output containing a PIU are reserved for its owner; additional context is assigned without duplication unless the allocation condition explicitly permits overlap. Multi-Agent PIU-Only provides the assigned PIU evidence, Multi-Agent Full-Context adds neutral additional repository material and actual runtime output, and Single-Agent All-PIU provides all pivotal information in a fixed order. The common observation identifies the task, repository, base commit, and response format without exposing PIU ownership or reference answers.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估分布为每位参与者使用一个 PIU。 包含 PIU 的来源或测试单元以及运行时输出保留给其所有者；附加上下文在不重复的情况下进行分配，除非分配条件明确允许重叠。 多智能体仅 PIU 提供已分配的 PIU 证据，多智能体全上下文在此基础上增加中立的附加仓库材料和实际运行时输出，单智能体全部 PIU 则以固定顺序提供所有关键信息。 共同观察内容标识任务、仓库、基础提交和响应格式，但不暴露 PIU 归属或参考答案。

sents.en: The evaluated distribution uses One PIU per participant.
sents.zh: 该评估分布为每位参与者使用一个 PIU。

sents.en: Source or test units and runtime output containing a PIU are reserved for its owner; additional context is assigned without duplication unless the allocation condition explicitly permits overlap.
sents.zh: 包含 PIU 的来源或测试单元以及运行时输出保留给其所有者；附加上下文在不重复的情况下进行分配，除非分配条件明确允许重叠。

sents.en: Multi-Agent PIU-Only provides the assigned PIU evidence, Multi-Agent Full-Context adds neutral additional repository material and actual runtime output, and Single-Agent All-PIU provides all pivotal information in a fixed order.
sents.zh: 多智能体仅 PIU 提供已分配的 PIU 证据，多智能体全上下文在此基础上增加中立的附加仓库材料和实际运行时输出，单智能体全部 PIU 则以固定顺序提供所有关键信息。

sents.en: The common observation identifies the task, repository, base commit, and response format without exposing PIU ownership or reference answers.
sents.zh: 共同观察内容标识任务、仓库、基础提交和响应格式，但不暴露 PIU 归属或参考答案。

paragraphs.en: For every participant, a model-based check determines whether the initial local observation contains or supports a PIU assigned to another participant, including information reconstructable by combining multiple passages. Topical overlap alone does not count. Revisions may remove or reassign additional context but may not remove the owner’s PIU evidence. The procedure also checks that PIU-bearing material is not identifiable from position, wrapper, annotation, or conspicuous length, and excludes instances that still contain foreign PIU information after bounded revision.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个参与者，基于模型的检查会判断其初始本地观测是否包含或支持分配给其他参与者的 PIU，包括通过组合多个段落可重构的信息。 仅主题重叠不计入。 修改可以移除或重新分配附加上下文，但不得移除属主的 PIU 证据。 该程序还检查含 PIU 的内容是否无法通过位置、包装、标注或醒目的长度被识别，并排除在有界修改后仍包含外来 PIU 信息的实例。

sents.en: For every participant, a model-based check determines whether the initial local observation contains or supports a PIU assigned to another participant, including information reconstructable by combining multiple passages.
sents.zh: 对于每个参与者，基于模型的检查会判断其初始本地观测是否包含或支持分配给其他参与者的 PIU，包括通过组合多个段落可重构的信息。

sents.en: Topical overlap alone does not count.
sents.zh: 仅主题重叠不计入。

sents.en: Revisions may remove or reassign additional context but may not remove the owner’s PIU evidence.
sents.zh: 修改可以移除或重新分配附加上下文，但不得移除属主的 PIU 证据。

sents.en: The procedure also checks that PIU-bearing material is not identifiable from position, wrapper, annotation, or conspicuous length, and excludes instances that still contain foreign PIU information after bounded revision.
sents.zh: 该程序还检查含 PIU 的内容是否无法通过位置、包装、标注或醒目的长度被识别，并排除在有界修改后仍包含外来 PIU 信息的实例。

paragraphs.en: DeepSWE provides long-horizon repository-level code-repair tasks, each defined by a pinned base repository, a public task instruction, and an official hidden verifier. A task may admit multiple verifier-passing patches, and repeated attempts by the same model may follow different search and implementation paths. The original DeepSWE evaluation accounts for this variation through repeated rollouts: its analysis uses three independent attempts by the same model on each task, while its final evaluation uses approximately four rollouts per task and model configuration. Successful GPT-5.5 repair trajectories take roughly 80 agent steps on average ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: DeepSWE 提供长时程的仓库级代码修复任务，每个任务由一个固定的基础仓库、一条公开的任务指令和一个官方隐藏验证器定义。 一个任务可能存在多个能通过验证器的补丁，同一模型的多次尝试可能遵循不同的搜索与实现路径。 原始的 DeepSWE 评估通过重复 rollout 来考虑这种差异：其分析使用同一模型在每个任务上的三次独立尝试，而其最终评估对每个任务和模型配置使用约四次 rollout。 成功的 GPT-5.5 修复轨迹平均需要大约 80 个智能体步骤（Huang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: DeepSWE provides long-horizon repository-level code-repair tasks, each defined by a pinned base repository, a public task instruction, and an official hidden verifier.
sents.zh: DeepSWE 提供长时程的仓库级代码修复任务，每个任务由一个固定的基础仓库、一条公开的任务指令和一个官方隐藏验证器定义。

sents.en: A task may admit multiple verifier-passing patches, and repeated attempts by the same model may follow different search and implementation paths.
sents.zh: 一个任务可能存在多个能通过验证器的补丁，同一模型的多次尝试可能遵循不同的搜索与实现路径。

sents.en: The original DeepSWE evaluation accounts for this variation through repeated rollouts: its analysis uses three independent attempts by the same model on each task, while its final evaluation uses approximately four rollouts per task and model configuration.
sents.zh: 原始的 DeepSWE 评估通过重复 rollout 来考虑这种差异：其分析使用同一模型在每个任务上的三次独立尝试，而其最终评估对每个任务和模型配置使用约四次 rollout。

sents.en: Successful GPT-5.5 repair trajectories take roughly 80 agent steps on average ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 成功的 GPT-5.5 修复轨迹平均需要大约 80 个智能体步骤（Huang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is not to reproduce this unrestricted long-horizon search, but to control the evidence required for collaboration under a fixed execution budget. We therefore define a DeepSWE PIU as a unit of functional evidence needed to support a successful repair under a fixed, bounded protocol. The complete PIU set is constructed so that, together with the public task instruction, it supports a verifier-passing patch using a restricted action space and five atomic edit turns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标不是重现这种不受限制的长程搜索，而是在固定的执行预算下控制协作所需的证据。 因此，我们将 DeepSWE PIU 定义为在固定且有界协议下支持成功修复所需的功能性证据单元。 完整的 PIU 集合的构建方式是：与公开的任务指令一起，它能够使用受限动作空间和五个原子编辑轮次，支持一个通过验证器的补丁。

sents.en: Our goal is not to reproduce this unrestricted long-horizon search, but to control the evidence required for collaboration under a fixed execution budget.
sents.zh: 我们的目标不是重现这种不受限制的长程搜索，而是在固定的执行预算下控制协作所需的证据。

sents.en: We therefore define a DeepSWE PIU as a unit of functional evidence needed to support a successful repair under a fixed, bounded protocol.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将 DeepSWE PIU 定义为在固定且有界协议下支持成功修复所需的功能性证据单元。

sents.en: The complete PIU set is constructed so that, together with the public task instruction, it supports a verifier-passing patch using a restricted action space and five atomic edit turns.
sents.zh: 完整的 PIU 集合的构建方式是：与公开的任务指令一起，它能够使用受限动作空间和五个原子编辑轮次，支持一个通过验证器的补丁。

paragraphs.en: We begin with 40 DeepSWE tasks. For each task, the model receives the public task instruction but no PIUs or additional code evidence. We give the model the same five-turn repair budget used in the subsequent evidence-bundle checks and run three independent attempts. We continue PIU construction only for tasks that fail all three instruction-only attempts. This screen removes tasks whose instructions already provide enough information to locate and implement a repair within the bounded protocol. The instruction-only runs therefore serve as the no-evidence, or “none,” condition for construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 40 个 DeepSWE 任务开始。 对于每个任务，模型只接收公开的任务指令，不接收任何 PIU 或额外的代码证据。 我们给模型与后续证据包检查中相同的五轮修复预算，并运行三次独立尝试。 我们只对三次仅指令尝试全部失败的任务继续构建 PIU。 这一筛选会剔除那些指令本身已提供足够信息、可在受限协议内定位并实现修复的任务。 因此，仅指令运行就充当了构建过程中的无证据（即「none」）条件。

sents.en: We begin with 40 DeepSWE tasks.
sents.zh: 我们从 40 个 DeepSWE 任务开始。

sents.en: For each task, the model receives the public task instruction but no PIUs or additional code evidence.
sents.zh: 对于每个任务，模型只接收公开的任务指令，不接收任何 PIU 或额外的代码证据。

sents.en: We give the model the same five-turn repair budget used in the subsequent evidence-bundle checks and run three independent attempts.
sents.zh: 我们给模型与后续证据包检查中相同的五轮修复预算，并运行三次独立尝试。

sents.en: We continue PIU construction only for tasks that fail all three instruction-only attempts.
sents.zh: 我们只对三次仅指令尝试全部失败的任务继续构建 PIU。

sents.en: This screen removes tasks whose instructions already provide enough information to locate and implement a repair within the bounded protocol.
sents.zh: 这一筛选会剔除那些指令本身已提供足够信息、可在受限协议内定位并实现修复的任务。

sents.en: The instruction-only runs therefore serve as the no-evidence, or “none,” condition for construction.
sents.zh: 因此，仅指令运行就充当了构建过程中的无证据（即「none」）条件。

paragraphs.en: For each candidate task, the constructor may inspect the reference patch, hidden-test patch and identifiers, public-check definitions and results, and the pinned base repository to locate implementation boundaries and audit evidence coverage. These materials are construction-only: the reference patch, hidden tests, verifier internals, hidden expected values, and constructor rationales are never copied into solver-visible evidence or exposed to evaluated agents. The public task instruction is common input to every condition and is not itself a PIU.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选任务，构建者可以查看参考补丁、隐藏测试补丁和标识符、公开检查的定义与结果，以及固定的基础仓库，以定位实现边界并审计证据覆盖情况。 这些材料仅用于构建：参考补丁、隐藏测试、验证器内部实现、隐藏的期望值以及构建者理由，绝不会被复制到求解器可见的证据中，也不会暴露给被评估的智能体。 公开任务指令是所有条件的共同输入，其本身并不构成 PIU。

sents.en: For each candidate task, the constructor may inspect the reference patch, hidden-test patch and identifiers, public-check definitions and results, and the pinned base repository to locate implementation boundaries and audit evidence coverage.
sents.zh: 对于每个候选任务，构建者可以查看参考补丁、隐藏测试补丁和标识符、公开检查的定义与结果，以及固定的基础仓库，以定位实现边界并审计证据覆盖情况。

sents.en: These materials are construction-only: the reference patch, hidden tests, verifier internals, hidden expected values, and constructor rationales are never copied into solver-visible evidence or exposed to evaluated agents.
sents.zh: 这些材料仅用于构建：参考补丁、隐藏测试、验证器内部实现、隐藏的期望值以及构建者理由，绝不会被复制到求解器可见的证据中，也不会暴露给被评估的智能体。

sents.en: The public task instruction is common input to every condition and is not itself a PIU.
sents.zh: 公开任务指令是所有条件的共同输入，其本身并不构成 PIU。

paragraphs.en: Construction collects exact task-relevant fragments from the unmodified base commit and deterministic runtime observations produced from the same checkout. Each observation records the executed probe, its output and exit status, and the repository state needed to interpret it. Observations may describe public base-repository behavior but do not reveal hidden assertions, hidden expected values, or solution code. Solver-visible evidence is therefore composed of base-commit code and reproducible base-repository behavior, not pieces of the reference patch.
paragraphs.zh: 构建过程从未经修改的基础提交中收集与任务精确相关的片段，并收集从同一检出版本生成的确定性运行时观察结果。 每条观察记录都记录了所执行的探针、其输出和退出状态，以及解释该结果所需的仓库状态。 观察结果可以描述公开的基础仓库行为，但不会泄露隐藏的断言、隐藏的期望值或解答代码。 因此，求解器可见的证据由基础提交代码和可复现的基础仓库行为组成，而非参考补丁的片段。

sents.en: Construction collects exact task-relevant fragments from the unmodified base commit and deterministic runtime observations produced from the same checkout.
sents.zh: 构建过程从未经修改的基础提交中收集与任务精确相关的片段，并收集从同一检出版本生成的确定性运行时观察结果。

sents.en: Each observation records the executed probe, its output and exit status, and the repository state needed to interpret it.
sents.zh: 每条观察记录都记录了所执行的探针、其输出和退出状态，以及解释该结果所需的仓库状态。

sents.en: Observations may describe public base-repository behavior but do not reveal hidden assertions, hidden expected values, or solution code.
sents.zh: 观察结果可以描述公开的基础仓库行为，但不会泄露隐藏的断言、隐藏的期望值或解答代码。

sents.en: Solver-visible evidence is therefore composed of base-commit code and reproducible base-repository behavior, not pieces of the reference patch.
sents.zh: 因此，求解器可见的证据由基础提交代码和可复现的基础仓库行为组成，而非参考补丁的片段。

paragraphs.en: A DeepSWE task may admit multiple implementations that pass the official verifier. Searching for a minimal evidence set relative to one reference patch could therefore steer the agent toward only one implementation path despite the existence of other valid repairs. We instead define each DeepSWE PIU to represent one coherent functional behavior or contract required by the verifier, rather than a fragment of a particular reference implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 DeepSWE 任务可能存在多种能通过官方验证器的实现方案。 因此，相对于某个参考补丁去搜索最小证据集，可能会在其他有效修复方案存在的情况下，把智能体引导至仅一条实现路径。 相反，我们将每个 DeepSWE PIU 定义为验证器所要求的一个连贯的功能行为或契约，而非某个特定参考实现的片段。

sents.en: A DeepSWE task may admit multiple implementations that pass the official verifier.
sents.zh: 一个 DeepSWE 任务可能存在多种能通过官方验证器的实现方案。

sents.en: Searching for a minimal evidence set relative to one reference patch could therefore steer the agent toward only one implementation path despite the existence of other valid repairs.
sents.zh: 因此，相对于某个参考补丁去搜索最小证据集，可能会在其他有效修复方案存在的情况下，把智能体引导至仅一条实现路径。

sents.en: We instead define each DeepSWE PIU to represent one coherent functional behavior or contract required by the verifier, rather than a fragment of a particular reference implementation.
sents.zh: 相反，我们将每个 DeepSWE PIU 定义为验证器所要求的一个连贯的功能行为或契约，而非某个特定参考实现的片段。

paragraphs.en: A functional PIU may combine several exact code fragments with deterministic runtime observations when they jointly specify an implementation boundary, such as parsing and validation, state accumulation, lifecycle and cleanup, persistence, public-API wiring, or error propagation. Supporting types, callers, interfaces, and exports are included when they are required to implement that behavior. Each selected code fragment or observation is assigned to exactly one PIU. Functional labels, evidence-selection rationales, and hidden failure information remain constructor metadata and are not included in participant packets.
paragraphs.zh: 一个功能性 PIU 可以在多个精确代码片段与确定性运行时观测共同规定一个实现边界时，将它们组合在一起，例如解析与校验、状态累积、生命周期与清理、持久化、公共 API 接线或错误传播。 支撑类型、调用方、接口和导出在实现该行为所必需时会包含在内。 每个被选中的代码片段或观测都恰好分配给一个 PIU。 功能性标签、证据选择依据以及隐藏的失败信息仍属于构造器元数据，不会包含在参与者数据包中。

sents.en: A functional PIU may combine several exact code fragments with deterministic runtime observations when they jointly specify an implementation boundary, such as parsing and validation, state accumulation, lifecycle and cleanup, persistence, public-API wiring, or error propagation.
sents.zh: 一个功能性 PIU 可以在多个精确代码片段与确定性运行时观测共同规定一个实现边界时，将它们组合在一起，例如解析与校验、状态累积、生命周期与清理、持久化、公共 API 接线或错误传播。

sents.en: Supporting types, callers, interfaces, and exports are included when they are required to implement that behavior.
sents.zh: 支撑类型、调用方、接口和导出在实现该行为所必需时会包含在内。

sents.en: Each selected code fragment or observation is assigned to exactly one PIU.
sents.zh: 每个被选中的代码片段或观测都恰好分配给一个 PIU。

sents.en: Functional labels, evidence-selection rationales, and hidden failure information remain constructor metadata and are not included in participant packets.
sents.zh: 功能性标签、证据选择依据以及隐藏的失败信息仍属于构造器元数据，不会包含在参与者数据包中。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of these PIUs is not to reproduce the reference patch. Each PIU is grounded in base-repository code and reproducible runtime behavior, and the complete PIU set must support a verifier-passing repair under the bounded protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 这些 PIU 的目的并不是复现参考补丁。 每个 PIU 都以基础仓库代码和可复现的运行时行为为依据，且完整的 PIU 集合必须支持在受限协议下通过验证器的修复。

sents.en: The purpose of these PIUs is not to reproduce the reference patch.
sents.zh: 这些 PIU 的目的并不是复现参考补丁。

sents.en: Each PIU is grounded in base-repository code and reproducible runtime behavior, and the complete PIU set must support a verifier-passing repair under the bounded protocol.
sents.zh: 每个 PIU 都以基础仓库代码和可复现的运行时行为为依据，且完整的 PIU 集合必须支持在受限协议下通过验证器的修复。

paragraphs.en: We inspect candidate PIU bundles with the same source-restricted repair interface used in evaluation. The patch author has five atomic edit turns and may invoke checks from a frozen public-check catalog. Repository mutation is restricted to replace , write , and delete operations, and the agent may terminate before using all five turns. After termination, the official hidden verifier is run once. Success is determined solely by whether the final patch passes this verifier; matching the reference patch is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用与评估中相同的源代码受限修复接口来检查候选 PIU 包。 补丁作者拥有五个原子编辑回合，并且可以调用来自冻结的公共检查目录中的检查。 仓库修改仅限于 replace、write 和 delete 操作，且智能体可以在用完全部五个回合之前终止。 终止之后，官方的隐藏验证器只运行一次。 成功与否仅取决于最终补丁是否通过该验证器；无需与参考补丁相匹配。

sents.en: We inspect candidate PIU bundles with the same source-restricted repair interface used in evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们使用与评估中相同的源代码受限修复接口来检查候选 PIU 包。

sents.en: The patch author has five atomic edit turns and may invoke checks from a frozen public-check catalog.
sents.zh: 补丁作者拥有五个原子编辑回合，并且可以调用来自冻结的公共检查目录中的检查。

sents.en: Repository mutation is restricted to replace , write , and delete operations, and the agent may terminate before using all five turns.
sents.zh: 仓库修改仅限于 replace、write 和 delete 操作，且智能体可以在用完全部五个回合之前终止。

sents.en: After termination, the official hidden verifier is run once.
sents.zh: 终止之后，官方的隐藏验证器只运行一次。

sents.en: Success is determined solely by whether the final patch passes this verifier; matching the reference patch is not required.
sents.zh: 成功与否仅取决于最终补丁是否通过该验证器；无需与参考补丁相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Each complete PIU bundle is evaluated in three independent qualification runs. These runs form the complete-evidence, or “all,” condition for construction. When all three instruction-only runs fail but the complete bundle enables a successful repair within the same five-turn protocol, the bundle provides operational evidence of sufficiency under that bounded protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 每个完整的 PIU 捆绑包都会在三次独立的资格运行中进行评估。 这些运行构成了构建阶段的完整证据条件，即“全部”条件。 当仅含指令的运行全部三次失败，而完整捆绑包能在同样的五轮协议内实现成功修复时，该捆绑包即在该有界协议下提供了其充分性的操作性证据。

sents.en: Each complete PIU bundle is evaluated in three independent qualification runs.
sents.zh: 每个完整的 PIU 捆绑包都会在三次独立的资格运行中进行评估。

sents.en: These runs form the complete-evidence, or “all,” condition for construction.
sents.zh: 这些运行构成了构建阶段的完整证据条件，即“全部”条件。

sents.en: When all three instruction-only runs fail but the complete bundle enables a successful repair within the same five-turn protocol, the bundle provides operational evidence of sufficiency under that bounded protocol.
sents.zh: 当仅含指令的运行全部三次失败，而完整捆绑包能在同样的五轮协议内实现成功修复时，该捆绑包即在该有界协议下提供了其充分性的操作性证据。

paragraphs.en: Repeated qualification outcomes and targeted leave-one-PIU-out checks are used diagnostically to refine the evidence bundle. We inspect whether removing a PIU reduces repair success or removes a functional boundary needed for the repair, and use the result to identify missing, irrelevant, or redundant evidence. Because repair trajectories are stochastic and multiple patches may pass the verifier, these leave-one-out checks are not treated as a formal proof of necessity over every possible repair procedure. They diagnose the contribution of each functional PIU under the fixed five-turn protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 重复的定性结果和有针对性的「去一PIU」检查被诊断性地用于完善证据包。 我们检查移除某个PIU是否会降低修复成功率，或移除修复所需的功能边界，并利用该结果识别缺失、无关或冗余的证据。 由于修复轨迹是随机的，且多个补丁可能通过验证器，这些去一检查不被视为对每种可能修复程序的必要性的形式证明。 它们在固定的五轮协议下诊断每个功能性PIU的贡献。

sents.en: Repeated qualification outcomes and targeted leave-one-PIU-out checks are used diagnostically to refine the evidence bundle.
sents.zh: 重复的定性结果和有针对性的「去一PIU」检查被诊断性地用于完善证据包。

sents.en: We inspect whether removing a PIU reduces repair success or removes a functional boundary needed for the repair, and use the result to identify missing, irrelevant, or redundant evidence.
sents.zh: 我们检查移除某个PIU是否会降低修复成功率，或移除修复所需的功能边界，并利用该结果识别缺失、无关或冗余的证据。

sents.en: Because repair trajectories are stochastic and multiple patches may pass the verifier, these leave-one-out checks are not treated as a formal proof of necessity over every possible repair procedure.
sents.zh: 由于修复轨迹是随机的，且多个补丁可能通过验证器，这些去一检查不被视为对每种可能修复程序的必要性的形式证明。

sents.en: They diagnose the contribution of each functional PIU under the fixed five-turn protocol.
sents.zh: 它们在固定的五轮协议下诊断每个功能性PIU的贡献。

paragraphs.en: After screening, evidence-bundle construction, and qualification, we freeze a 12-task evaluation cohort from the initial 40 tasks. The cohort contains four Go, four Python, two JavaScript, and two TypeScript tasks and preserves both programming-language coverage and variation in original benchmark difficulty. These 12 tasks are the constructed and evaluated DeepSWE problem instances reported in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 经过筛选、证据包构建和资格审核后，我们从最初的 40 个任务中冻结出一个包含 12 个任务的评估队列。 该队列包含四个 Go 任务、四个 Python 任务、两个 JavaScript 任务和两个 TypeScript 任务，同时保留了编程语言的覆盖面以及原始基准测试难度的多样性。 这 12 个任务即是表 2 中报告的经过构建和评估的 DeepSWE 问题实例。

sents.en: After screening, evidence-bundle construction, and qualification, we freeze a 12-task evaluation cohort from the initial 40 tasks.
sents.zh: 经过筛选、证据包构建和资格审核后，我们从最初的 40 个任务中冻结出一个包含 12 个任务的评估队列。

sents.en: The cohort contains four Go, four Python, two JavaScript, and two TypeScript tasks and preserves both programming-language coverage and variation in original benchmark difficulty.
sents.zh: 该队列包含四个 Go 任务、四个 Python 任务、两个 JavaScript 任务和两个 TypeScript 任务，同时保留了编程语言的覆盖面以及原始基准测试难度的多样性。

sents.en: These 12 tasks are the constructed and evaluated DeepSWE problem instances reported in Table 2 .
sents.zh: 这 12 个任务即是表 2 中报告的经过构建和评估的 DeepSWE 问题实例。

paragraphs.en: The final functional PIUs are assigned one per participant. In Single-Agent All-PIU, one patch author receives the ordered union of all PIU evidence. In Multi-Agent PIU-Only, each participant receives only its assigned functional PIU. In Multi-Agent Full-Context, each participant receives its assigned PIU together with non-PIU base-repository code and additional runtime context.
paragraphs.zh: 最终的功能性 PIU 分配给每位参与者一个。 在单智能体 All-PIU 设置中，一名补丁作者接收所有 PIU 证据的有序并集。 在多智能体 PIU-Only 设置中，每位参与者仅接收其被分配的功能性 PIU。 在多智能体 Full-Context 设置中，每位参与者接收其被分配的 PIU，以及非 PIU 的基础仓库代码和额外的运行时上下文。

sents.en: The final functional PIUs are assigned one per participant.
sents.zh: 最终的功能性 PIU 分配给每位参与者一个。

sents.en: In Single-Agent All-PIU, one patch author receives the ordered union of all PIU evidence.
sents.zh: 在单智能体 All-PIU 设置中，一名补丁作者接收所有 PIU 证据的有序并集。

sents.en: In Multi-Agent PIU-Only, each participant receives only its assigned functional PIU.
sents.zh: 在多智能体 PIU-Only 设置中，每位参与者仅接收其被分配的功能性 PIU。

sents.en: In Multi-Agent Full-Context, each participant receives its assigned PIU together with non-PIU base-repository code and additional runtime context.
sents.zh: 在多智能体 Full-Context 设置中，每位参与者接收其被分配的 PIU，以及非 PIU 的基础仓库代码和额外的运行时上下文。

paragraphs.en: Non-PIU code fragments in the Full-Context packets are distributed exclusively across participants. Additional runtime context uses only previously collected observations; selected non-owned observations may be duplicated as distractors across participant packets. No participant receives the entire repository. The collaborative transcript is sequential and coordinator-selected, and the final patch author acts on the public transcript using the same five-turn repair interface and public-check catalog. No condition exposes PIU identifiers, the reference patch, hidden-test information, hidden expected values, or constructor rationales.
paragraphs.zh: 完整上下文数据包中的非 PIU 代码片段以独占方式分布于各参与者之间。 额外的运行时上下文仅使用先前收集的观察记录；被选中的非自有观察记录可能作为干扰项在多个参与者数据包中重复出现。 没有任何参与者会收到整个代码库。 协作对话记录是按顺序且由协调者挑选的，最终补丁的作者依据公开的对话记录，使用相同的五轮修复接口和公开检查目录进行操作。 任何条件下都不会暴露 PIU 标识符、参考补丁、隐藏测试信息、隐藏的期望值或构造函数的相关说明。

sents.en: Non-PIU code fragments in the Full-Context packets are distributed exclusively across participants.
sents.zh: 完整上下文数据包中的非 PIU 代码片段以独占方式分布于各参与者之间。

sents.en: Additional runtime context uses only previously collected observations; selected non-owned observations may be duplicated as distractors across participant packets.
sents.zh: 额外的运行时上下文仅使用先前收集的观察记录；被选中的非自有观察记录可能作为干扰项在多个参与者数据包中重复出现。

sents.en: No participant receives the entire repository.
sents.zh: 没有任何参与者会收到整个代码库。

sents.en: The collaborative transcript is sequential and coordinator-selected, and the final patch author acts on the public transcript using the same five-turn repair interface and public-check catalog.
sents.zh: 协作对话记录是按顺序且由协调者挑选的，最终补丁的作者依据公开的对话记录，使用相同的五轮修复接口和公开检查目录进行操作。

sents.en: No condition exposes PIU identifiers, the reference patch, hidden-test information, hidden expected values, or constructor rationales.
sents.zh: 任何条件下都不会暴露 PIU 标识符、参考补丁、隐藏测试信息、隐藏的期望值或构造函数的相关说明。

paragraphs.en: To account for stochastic repair trajectories, we schedule three independent runs for each task–model–condition combination. Within each task and condition, we first average the available verifier outcomes across repetitions and then average across the 12 tasks, giving each task equal weight.
paragraphs.zh: 为了考虑随机性的修复轨迹，我们为每个「任务–模型–条件」组合安排三次独立运行。 在每个任务和条件下，我们首先对多次重复中可用的验证器结果取平均，然后再对 12 个任务取平均，使每个任务的权重相同。

sents.en: To account for stochastic repair trajectories, we schedule three independent runs for each task–model–condition combination.
sents.zh: 为了考虑随机性的修复轨迹，我们为每个「任务–模型–条件」组合安排三次独立运行。

sents.en: Within each task and condition, we first average the available verifier outcomes across repetitions and then average across the 12 tasks, giving each task equal weight.
sents.zh: 在每个任务和条件下，我们首先对多次重复中可用的验证器结果取平均，然后再对 12 个任务取平均，使每个任务的权重相同。

paragraphs.en: A completed verifier failure, an ordinary unsuccessful repair, or a confirmed context-window failure receives a score of zero and remains in the denominator. A run is marked unavailable and excluded only when no valid task outcome can be obtained because of provider-capacity, API or serving, container or Docker, or missing-verifier-result failures. Availability exclusions are recorded separately from completed task failures.
paragraphs.zh: 已完成的验证器失败、普通的修复失败，或确认的上下文窗口失败，得分为零并保留在分母中。 只有当由于提供商容量、API 或服务、容器或 Docker，或缺少验证器结果等故障而无法获得有效的任务结果时，该运行才被标记为不可用并予以排除。 可用性排除与已完成的任务失败分开记录。

sents.en: A completed verifier failure, an ordinary unsuccessful repair, or a confirmed context-window failure receives a score of zero and remains in the denominator.
sents.zh: 已完成的验证器失败、普通的修复失败，或确认的上下文窗口失败，得分为零并保留在分母中。

sents.en: A run is marked unavailable and excluded only when no valid task outcome can be obtained because of provider-capacity, API or serving, container or Docker, or missing-verifier-result failures.
sents.zh: 只有当由于提供商容量、API 或服务、容器或 Docker，或缺少验证器结果等故障而无法获得有效的任务结果时，该运行才被标记为不可用并予以排除。

sents.en: Availability exclusions are recorded separately from completed task failures.
sents.zh: 可用性排除与已完成的任务失败分开记录。

paragraphs.en: All problem instances undergo checks during PIU construction, and the participant-level source-material check is performed after source-material distribution. Centralized solver success additionally establishes operational answerability, but does not by itself validate leave-one-out pivotality or the participant-level source-material check. We therefore conducted an additional post-construction audit of 20 instances from the fixed 30-instance MAUD evaluation set and 20 instances from the fixed 30-instance FinLongDocQA evaluation set. We used GPT-5.4, which was not used for instance construction, as the primary evaluator. The sample was frozen before evaluation. The audit covered every selected instance under every PIU leave-one-out removal and each participant’s initial local observation together with the initial common observation. Solver outputs and answer accuracy were not used as evidence in these judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 所有问题实例在 PIU 构建过程中都会接受检查，而参与者层级的源材料检查则在源材料分发之后进行。 集中式求解器成功还能额外确立操作性可答性，但其本身并不能验证留一关键性或参与者层级的源材料检查。 因此，我们对固定的 30 实例 MAUD 评估集和固定的 30 实例 FinLongDocQA 评估集中的各 20 个实例进行了额外的构建后审计。 我们使用未参与实例构建的 GPT-5.4 作为主要评估者。 样本在评估前已被冻结。 该审计覆盖了每个被选中实例在每一次 PIU 留一移除下的情况，以及每位参与者的初始本地观察和初始共同观察。 求解器的输出与答案准确率未在这些判断中作为证据使用。

sents.zh: 所有问题实例在 PIU 构建过程中都会接受检查，而参与者层级的源材料检查则在源材料分发之后进行。

paragraphs.en: For the leave-one-out pivotality check, a removal passes only when the linked answer component becomes unsupported or genuinely unresolved. The participant-level source-material check passes at the instance level only when no participant’s initial local observation together with the initial common observation grounds the complete reference decision.
paragraphs.zh: 对于留一枢纽性检验，只有当被移除后相关的答案组成部分变为不受支持或确实未解决时，该移除才算通过。 参与者层面的源材料检验只有在没有任何参与者的初始局部观察与初始共同观察共同支撑完整的引用决策时，才在实例层面通过。

sents.en: For the leave-one-out pivotality check, a removal passes only when the linked answer component becomes unsupported or genuinely unresolved.
sents.zh: 对于留一枢纽性检验，只有当被移除后相关的答案组成部分变为不受支持或确实未解决时，该移除才算通过。

sents.en: The participant-level source-material check passes at the instance level only when no participant’s initial local observation together with the initial common observation grounds the complete reference decision.
sents.zh: 参与者层面的源材料检验只有在没有任何参与者的初始局部观察与初始共同观察共同支撑完整的引用决策时，才在实例层面通过。

paragraphs.en: This is targeted independent validation of two representative construction regimes and is not an independent revalidation of every retained instance or source corpus. An unclear, invalid, failed, or missing judgment is counted as non-passing.
paragraphs.zh: 这是对两种具有代表性的构建机制的针对性独立验证，而非对每个保留实例或源语料库的独立再验证。 不明确、无效、失败或缺失的判定均计为未通过。

paragraphs.en: Across the two validated construction regimes, the leave-one-out results provide the strongest evidence that retained PIUs are individually pivotal. The participant-level source-material check finds that no participant’s initial observation is sufficient for a complete grounded decision in any selected FinLongDocQA instance and identifies two MAUD instances in which one participant’s initial observation together with the initial common observation is sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个经过验证的构建机制中，留一法结果提供了最有力的证据，表明保留的 PIU 各自都是关键的。 参与者层面的源材料检查发现，在任何选定的 FinLongDocQA 实例中，没有任何参与者的初始观察足以做出完整的依据充分的决策，并识别出两个 MAUD 实例，其中某位参与者的初始观察加上初始共同观察是充分的。

paragraphs.en: The first three subsections disaggregate the model–domain results in Figure 6 . Every reported comparison uses the same problem instances, their pivotal information, and the problem-specific evaluator across the three evaluation conditions within a source corpus. The legal, finance, medical, and software-engineering evaluations use One PIU per participant. All team episodes use Coordinator-selected speaker with 15 participant responses before the final decision. Within each model–source-corpus comparison, the two multi-agent conditions hold this PIU distribution, communication structure, and the source-corpus-specific resource budgets fixed. The results do not pool different communication structures or PIU-distribution conditions within an episode. For the three evaluation conditions in Figure 6 , confirmed context-window failures count as unsuccessful episodes, whereas episodes without a valid outcome because of provider-capacity or other infrastructure failures are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 前三个小节对图6中的模型–领域结果进行分解展示。 在每个源语料库内的三种评估条件中，所有报告的比较都使用相同的问题实例、其关键信息以及特定于问题的评估器。 法律、金融、医疗和软件工程评估对每个参与者使用一个 PIU。 所有团队回合都使用由协调者选定的发言者，并在最终决策前进行15次参与者回应。 在每个模型–源语料库比较中，两种多智能体条件都将该 PIU 分布、通信结构以及特定于源语料库的资源预算保持不变。 结果不会在同一个回合内汇集不同的通信结构或 PIU 分布条件。 对于图6中的三种评估条件，已确认的上下文窗口失败计为不成功的回合，而由于提供商容量或其他基础设施故障导致没有有效结果的回合则为不可用。

paragraphs.en: Table 30 reports the complete three-condition model and source-corpus results underlying the domain and source-corpus summaries, together with available Single-Agent Full-Context estimates. In that condition, one model receives the ordered union of the source material assigned under the same fixed PIU distribution. Each row averages episode success over the fixed problem instances for one model and source corpus. Within a row, the two multi-agent conditions use the same fixed PIU distributions, communication structure, and resource budgets. The table does not pool the additional PIU-distribution conditions or communication structures. For legal Single-Agent Full-Context, the episode-success denominator includes evaluated inputs and structured-interface failures at the final-decision stage, with the latter counted as unsuccessful episodes. Serving-context rejections and other evaluation errors are excluded. When fewer than the fixed inputs contribute to an estimate, the table shows its denominator as n / N n/N . An em dash in the Single-Agent Full-Context column means that the current archive does not provide a comparable success estimate; it does not convert an unavailable result into a failure.

paragraphs.en: The reported episode success rate is a strict end-to-end measure. We define a structured-interface failure as an episode that does not produce a valid final decision because a participant response or final-decision response cannot be parsed under the required structured response format. A valid final decision is one that is successfully parsed and passed to the problem-specific evaluator. Structured-interface failures remain unsuccessful episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 所报告的片段成功率是一项严格的端到端指标。 我们将结构化接口失败定义为这样一个片段：由于参与者的响应或最终决策响应无法按照所需的结构化响应格式进行解析，因而未能产生有效的最终决策。 有效的最终决策是指被成功解析并传递给针对具体问题的评估器的决策。 结构化接口失败仍被视为未成功的片段。

sents.zh: 所报告的片段成功率是一项严格的端到端指标。

paragraphs.en: Across the primary legal evaluation, each of the three evaluation conditions contains 1,304 episodes. In 276 multi-agent episodes, a participant response cannot be parsed and the episode terminates before the final-decision stage. Four additional episodes reach the final-decision stage but do not produce a valid final-decision response. Of these 280 structured-interface failures, 254 are produced by the two Claude models: 250 occur during participant interaction and four at the final-decision stage.
paragraphs.zh: 在主要法律评估中，三个评估条件各包含 1,304 个回合。 在 276 个多智能体回合中，参与者响应无法解析，回合在最终决策阶段之前终止。 另有四个回合到达最终决策阶段，但未产生有效的最终决策响应。 在这 280 个结构化接口失败中，254 个由两个 Claude 模型产生：250 个发生在参与者交互期间，四个发生在最终决策阶段。

sents.zh: 在主要法律评估中，三个评估条件各包含 1,304 个回合。

paragraphs.en: The failure records do not support reliable semantic rescoring. For failed responses, the archive retains only the first 500 characters and does not record the complete raw response, provider finish reason, or output-token count. We therefore cannot reliably distinguish schema noncompliance from generation truncation or determine what a model would have produced had generation continued.
paragraphs.zh: 失败记录不支持可靠的语义重新评分。 对于失败的响应，归档仅保留前 500 个字符，不会记录完整的原始响应、提供商的完成原因或输出令牌数量。 因此，我们无法可靠地区分模式不合规与生成截断，也无法确定如果生成继续进行模型本会产出什么内容。

paragraphs.en: Among episodes that produce a valid final decision, the corresponding diagnostic success rates are 75.5%, 55.0%, and 35.1%. The communication and retrieval gaps therefore remain 20.5 and 19.9 percentage points, respectively. These conditional rates are descriptive rather than alternative estimates of end-to-end performance: producing a valid final decision is itself an outcome that can depend on the model and evaluation condition.
paragraphs.zh: 在产生有效最终决策的回合中，相应的诊断成功率为75.5%、55.0%和35.1%。 因此，沟通差距和检索差距分别保持在20.5和19.9个百分点。 这些条件比率仅具描述性，并非对端到端性能的替代性估计：能否产生有效的最终决策本身就是一个可能依赖于模型和评估条件的结果。

paragraphs.en: As an additional sensitivity analysis, excluding both Claude models gives strict aggregate legal episode success rates of 69.8%, 49.4%, and 32.3% in Single-Agent All-PIU, Multi-Agent PIU-Only, and Multi-Agent Full-Context, respectively. Conditional on producing a valid final decision, the corresponding rates are 69.8%, 49.7%, and 33.0%. The strict gaps are 20.4 and 17.1 percentage points, and the conditional gaps are 20.1 and 16.7 points.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一项额外的敏感性分析，排除两个 Claude 模型后，Single-Agent All-PIU、Multi-Agent PIU-Only 和 Multi-Agent Full-Context 三种设置下的严格总体法律情节成功率分别为 69.8%、49.4% 和 32.3%。 在产出有效最终决策的条件下，相应的比率为 69.8%、49.7% 和 33.0%。 严格差距分别为 20.4 和 17.1 个百分点，条件差距分别为 20.1 和 16.7 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports the labeling criteria and transcript interventions for correct synthesis and error uptake summarized in Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告了第 4.3 节总结的关于正确合成与错误吸收的标注标准与转录处理方式。

paragraphs.en: A PIU is faithfully communicated when a participant message preserves its meaning without changing its value, entity, scope, qualification, or effect. An error is an incorrect or unsupported sentence or component that could affect the final decision. Error uptake occurs when a later participant uses an error from a previous visible message to produce a new sentence; rejecting or correcting the earlier error does not count. The intended synthesis criterion is an inference that combines at least two distinct PIUs; repeating one PIU or merely proposing an answer does not count. A synthesis inference is correct when it is supported by the reference PIUs and reference decision. An explicit answer proposal directly states the final choice or requested answer.
paragraphs.zh: 当参与者消息在不改变其价值、实体、范围、限定或效果的情况下保留了某个 PIU 的含义时，该 PIU 即被忠实传达。 错误是指可能影响最终决策的不正确或无依据的句子或成分。 当后续参与者使用先前可见消息中的错误来产出新句子时，即发生错误承接；拒绝或纠正先前的错误不算错误承接。 预期的综合标准是结合至少两个不同 PIU 的推断；重复单个 PIU 或仅提出答案不算。 当综合推断有参考 PIU 和参考决策支持时，该推断即正确。 显式答案提议直接陈述最终选择或所请求的答案。

paragraphs.en: The analysis uses 474 frozen Multi-Agent PIU-Only trajectories: 79 problem instances crossed with Round robin, Current-speaker selection, and Simultaneous responses, for Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B participants; Section 4.3 abbreviates the latter as Qwen3-235B. Every participant receives exactly one PIU. A separate GPT-5.5 auditor labels sentence-level components. Participants are not rerun. Instead, we reconstruct the transcript supplied to the final decision maker and regenerate the final decision. The intervention results pool Round robin and Current-speaker selection, giving 158 original trajectories for each participant-model–final-decision-maker combination; intervention effects are paired within trajectory, and confidence intervals are paired 95% bootstrap intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析使用474条冻结的Multi-Agent PIU-Only轨迹：79个问题实例与轮询（Round robin）、当前发言者选择（Current-speaker selection）和同时响应（Simultaneous responses）三种方式交叉，参与者为Qwen3-32B和Qwen3-235B-A22B；第4.3节将后者简称为Qwen3-235B。 每位参与者恰好收到一个PIU。 由独立的GPT-5.5审计者标注句子级成分。 参与者不会被重新运行。 相反，我们重建提供给最终决策者的对话记录，并重新生成最终决策。 干预结果合并了轮询（Round robin）和当前发言者选择（Current-speaker selection），为每个参与者模型–最终决策者组合提供158条原始轨迹；干预效应在轨迹内配对，置信区间为配对的95%自助法（bootstrap）区间。

Because S ⁡ ( T ) S(T) excludes explicit answer proposals, this effect cannot be attributed to direct answer copying.

The auditor-labeled set used here also includes some inferences that combine one PIU with information from the publicly visible decision options. Accordingly, the reported effects apply to this broader auditor-labeled set and should not be interpreted as isolating synthesis across distinct PIUs.

paragraphs.en: The control is the reconstructed original transcript. In the intervention, we remove later sentences produced using an error from a previous visible message, while retaining the sentence containing the original error. This isolates the additional effect of later participants taking up the error. A positive effect means that removing error-uptake sentences improves episode success.

paragraphs.en: Removing error uptake improves episode success for Qwen3-235B-A22B participants under both final decision makers. The Qwen3-32B estimates have the same sign, but their confidence intervals include zero. These effects are smaller than the corresponding correct-synthesis effects in all four comparisons and do not by themselves explain the communication-structure ordering. We do not apply the error-uptake intervention to Simultaneous responses because participants cannot observe one another; incorrect or inconsistent simultaneous messages are independent rather than propagated errors.

paragraphs.en: Because each problem instance belongs to exactly one problem family, the problem-instance fixed effects absorb the problem-family fixed effects rather than entering the model alongside them. paragraphs.en: The problem-instance fixed effects absorb differences in absolute difficulty among the evaluated problem instances. The reported interactions therefore compare changes across PIU distributions and communication structures within the same problem instances. The positive Pairwise PIU overlap–Round robin interaction in Multi-Agent Full-Context has a 95% confidence interval that excludes zero only with problem-instance fixed effects. The negative One common PIU–Simultaneous responses Multi-Agent PIU-Only interaction has a 95% confidence interval that includes zero with problem-instance fixed effects.
paragraphs.zh: 问题实例固定效应吸收了被评估问题实例之间在绝对难度上的差异。 因此，所报告的交互效应比较的是同一问题实例内部不同 PIU 分布和沟通结构之间的变化。 与主分析一样，相同的五个正向多智能体 PIU-Only 交互和相同的两个负向多智能体 Full-Context 交互的 95% 置信区间不包含零，且点估计值相近。 多智能体 Full-Context 中的正向 Pairwise PIU 重叠–Round robin 交互，只有在加入问题实例固定效应时，其 95% 置信区间才不包含零。 多智能体 PIU-Only 中的负向 One common PIU–Simultaneous responses 交互，在加入问题实例固定效应后，其 95% 置信区间包含零。

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports the matched comparisons and interventions accompanying Section 4.4 . The cross-domain interaction estimates and problem-instance fixed-effects analysis remain in Appendix E.5 and Appendix E.6 . The finance experiments vary what a coordinator query asks the selected participant to communicate, including by appending public PIU category labels for its assigned PIUs and an instruction to report evidence for each. Speaker selection is held fixed in these interventions. The SARA experiments vary who receives private source material and which participant messages the final decision maker sees. These experiments use separate problem-instance sets and do not estimate the fraction of the cross-domain regression interaction attributable to either mechanism. All effects below concern episode success unless stated otherwise; percentage-point estimates are calculated before rounding the displayed rates.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告与 4.4 节配套的匹配比较和干预。 跨领域交互估计和问题实例固定效应分析仍保留在附录 E.5 和附录 E.6 中。 金融实验改变协调者查询要求被选中参与者传达的内容，包括为其分配的 PIU 附加公开的 PIU 类别标签，以及要求其为每个 PIU 报告证据的指令。 在这些干预中，说话者选择保持不变。 SARA 实验改变谁接收私享源材料，以及最终决策者能看到哪些参与者的消息。 这些实验使用独立的问题实例集合，并不估计跨领域回归交互中可归因于任一机制的比例。 除非另有说明，下述所有效应均针对回合成功；百分点估计值在显示的比率四舍五入之前计算。

paragraphs.en: The matched communication comparison uses 59 finance problem instances: 30 FinDVer and 29 FinLongDocQA instances. The primary comparison pools Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B, with the same model used for the participants and the coordinator or separate final decision maker within an episode. The design crosses One PIU per participant and All-but-one PIU concentration with Coordinator-selected speaker and Round robin, giving 472 primary episodes and 118 problem-instance–model pairs per condition. Participants receive private source material. The interaction compares the difference in episode success between Round robin and Coordinator-selected speaker under All-but-one PIU concentration with the same difference under One PIU per participant.
paragraphs.zh: 匹配的通信对比使用59个金融问题实例：30个FinDVer实例和29个FinLongDocQA实例。 主要对比合并了Qwen3-32B和Qwen3-235B-A22B，参与者与协调者或回合内独立的最终决策者使用相同的模型。 该设计将每个参与者一个PIU与除一个外全部PIU集中这两种设置，与协调者选择发言者和轮流转这两种机制进行交叉组合，得到472个主要回合，每个条件下118个问题实例–模型对。 参与者接收私有的源材料。 该交互对比在除一个外全部PIU集中条件下轮流转与协调者选择发言者之间的回合成功率差异，与在每个参与者一个PIU条件下的相同差异进行比较。

sents.zh: 匹配的通信对比使用59个金融问题实例：30个FinDVer实例和29个FinLongDocQA实例。

sents.zh: 该交互对比在除一个外全部PIU集中条件下轮流转与协调者选择发言者之间的回合成功率差异，与在每个参与者一个PIU条件下的相同差异进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The original public participant descriptions summarize a participant’s subject matter or function, without enumerating the public information categories corresponding to its assigned PIUs. These categories describe what the evidence concerns; they do not disclose the evidence itself. Across the 59 problem instances, their mean lengths are 4.41 words under One PIU per participant and 5.10 words under All-but-one PIU concentration. The 54 participants assigned multiple PIUs have six-word descriptions but a mean of 3.43 public information categories (range 2–6). A brief description thus need not indicate every category of evidence available from a participant assigned multiple PIUs.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的公开参与者描述概括了参与者的主题或职能，并未逐一列出与其被分配的PIU相对应的公开信息类别。 这些类别描述的是证据所涉及的内容，并不披露证据本身。 在59个问题实例中，这些描述的平均长度在“每位参与者一个PIU”设置下为4.41个词，在“除一个PIU外的全部PIU集中”设置下为5.10个词。 被分配多个PIU的54名参与者拥有六个词的描述，但其公开信息类别的均值为3.43（范围2–6）。 因此，简短的描述并不需要列出被分配多个PIU的参与者可提供的每一类证据。

paragraphs.en: The observed communication difference permits two explanations: the coordinator may fail to select a participant assigned a needed PIU, or its query may limit the evidence that the selected participant reports. Near-complete coverage of required participants motivates the second account. Under Coordinator-selected speaker, the selected participant receives a specific query from the coordinator; under Round robin, there is no coordinator query and the participant responds to the whole decision problem. A query covering one PIU may suffice when the participant holds only that PIU, but may omit other assigned PIUs when several are concentrated with it. If this account is correct, broadening the requested evidence should improve episode success more when one selected participant holds multiple PIUs. We therefore change query content while retaining the source episode’s speaker selection.
paragraphs.zh: 所观察到的沟通差异允许两种解释：协调者可能未能选择被指派了所需 PIU 的参与者，或者协调者的查询可能限制了被选参与者所报告的证据。 对所需参与者接近完全的覆盖支持第二种解释。 在「协调者选择发言者」条件下，被选参与者会收到协调者提出的具体查询；在「轮流发言」条件下，没有协调者查询，参与者针对整个决策问题作答。 当参与者仅持有一个 PIU 时，覆盖该 PIU 的查询可能已经足够，但当多个 PIU 集中在同一名参与者身上时，查询可能遗漏其中部分被指派的 PIU。 如果这一解释是正确的，那么当一名被选参与者持有多个 PIU 时，拓宽所请求的证据应当更能提高回合的成功率。 因此，我们在保留源回合发言者选择方式的同时，改变查询的内容。

paragraphs.en: All query interventions operate within Coordinator-selected speaker. The original coordinator query is the task-specific question recorded in the source episode. For each source episode, we replay the recorded sequence of selected participants and the number of responses. The source material, model, PIU distribution, resource budgets, and final-decision procedure are held fixed across query conditions; participant responses and final decisions are regenerated. Original coordinator queries are not regenerated in response to the new participant messages. The resulting effects apply to this fixed sequence, rather than to a coordinator that adapts its later selections or queries.
paragraphs.zh: 所有查询干预均在协调器选定的发言智能体范围内进行。 原始协调器查询是源片段中记录的任务特定问题。 对于每个源片段，我们重放所记录的选定参与者序列以及回复次数。 源材料、模型、PIU 分布、资源预算和最终决策程序在各个查询条件下保持不变；参与者回复和最终决策则重新生成。 原始协调器查询不会针对新的参与者消息重新生成。 由此产生的效果作用于这一固定序列，而非会调整后续选择或查询的协调器。

sents.en: All query interventions operate within Coordinator-selected speaker.
sents.zh: 所有查询干预均在协调器选定的发言智能体范围内进行。

sents.en: The original coordinator query is the task-specific question recorded in the source episode.
sents.zh: 原始协调器查询是源片段中记录的任务特定问题。

sents.en: For each source episode, we replay the recorded sequence of selected participants and the number of responses.
sents.zh: 对于每个源片段，我们重放所记录的选定参与者序列以及回复次数。

sents.en: The source material, model, PIU distribution, resource budgets, and final-decision procedure are held fixed across query conditions; participant responses and final decisions are regenerated.
sents.zh: 源材料、模型、PIU 分布、资源预算和最终决策程序在各个查询条件下保持不变；参与者回复和最终决策则重新生成。

sents.en: Original coordinator queries are not regenerated in response to the new participant messages.
sents.zh: 原始协调器查询不会针对新的参与者消息重新生成。

sents.en: The resulting effects apply to this fixed sequence, rather than to a coordinator that adapts its later selections or queries.
sents.zh: 由此产生的效果作用于这一固定序列，而非会调整后续选择或查询的协调器。

paragraphs.en: After speaker selection, one intervention appends a numbered list of the public PIU category labels corresponding to the selected participant’s assigned PIUs and an instruction to report the supporting facts or numbers for each category. The added list contains short public PIU category labels, without private source text, detailed evidence, values, answers, entity scope, or period scope. It augments the original query; it does not replace the participant description or alter speaker selection. For example, an original description is “service proceeds and cybersecurity operations reviewer.” The added list includes service agreement proceeds details, cybersecurity operations exposure, liquidity going-concern assessment, cryptocurrency market exposure, earnings profitability outlook, and share-based compensation expense. These labels specify the topics of the assigned evidence, without supplying the proceeds, expenses, or other private facts needed to answer the problem. Categories need not correspond one-to-one to PIUs: several PIUs may concern the same category.
paragraphs.zh: 在说话者选择之后，一次干预会附加一个编号列表，其中列出与被选中参与者所分配 PIU 对应的公开 PIU 类别标签，并附上一条指令，要求为每个类别报告支持性事实或数字。 所添加的列表只包含简短的公开 PIU 类别标签，不含私有源文本、详细证据、数值、答案、实体范围或期间范围。 它是对原始查询的增强；它不会替换参与者描述，也不会改变说话者选择。 例如，原始描述为「服务收入与网络安全运营审查员」。所添加的列表包括服务协议收入细节、网络安全运营风险敞口、流动性持续经营评估、加密货币市场风险敞口、盈利能力展望以及股份支付费用。 这些标签指明了所分配证据的主题，但不提供回答问题所需的收入、费用或其他私有事实。 类别与 PIU 不必一一对应：多个 PIU 可能涉及同一类别。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the additions are necessary or removing the narrow query suffices, we replace each original coordinator query with “It is your turn to contribute,” both with and without the public PIU category labels and instruction. This produces 1,416 additional primary episodes. Together with the 1,416 episodes retaining the original queries, the 2 × 2 2\times 2 design crosses query retention versus removal with presence versus absence of the additions under each PIU distribution, giving 2,832 episodes. The original-query comparators are reused from the preceding experiment; they are not generated again for the query-removal comparison.

paragraphs.en: Follow-up generation uses temperature 0.2, a 40,000-token private-context budget per participant, 600-token participant and coordinator utterance caps, and a 1,200-token final rationale budget. Complete queries including the public PIU category labels and instruction satisfy the existing 600-token cap. A temperature-0 GPT-5.5 evaluator scores episode success and a continuous score on a 0–1 scale. A separate temperature-0 GPT-5.5 semantic evaluation compares each PIU’s reference evidence with its assigned participant’s public messages. Substantive communication requires accurate content-bearing evidence; complete communication additionally requires all key task-relevant elements. Repeating a category label alone does not count.

paragraphs.en: For both follow-up experiments, three repetitions are averaged within each problem-instance–model–PIU-distribution–query-condition combination. All primary confidence intervals use 20,000 percentile bootstrap draws over the 59 problem-instance clusters, retaining both models and all matched conditions together. For the fixed-Round-robin analysis, each draw recomputes I ⁡ ( k ) I(k) and the difference between query conditions. The original communication comparison uses the same cluster-bootstrap procedure. No instance or repetition is excluded based on its observed outcome.

paragraphs.en: An outcome-selected audit covers all three actor models, including GPT-5.5. It examines the 47 original problem-instance–model pairs in which Coordinator-selected speaker failed and Round robin succeeded under All-but-one PIU concentration. A temperature-0 GPT-5.5 auditor saw both concentrated transcripts and the corresponding One PIU per participant transcripts. Condition names and success labels were withheld, while transcript structure remained visible. The auditor attributed the primary difference to queries limiting response scope in 44 pairs and to a mixture of mechanisms in three. These selected frequencies are supporting process evidence, rather than population mechanism frequencies or causal mediation estimates.

paragraphs.en: For an HLI 2024 10-Q problem instance with Qwen3-235B-A22B, the original coordinator query asked about Financial Restructuring fee recognition. The selected participant also held evidence about acquisition consideration, income-tax factors, and the quarterly compensation ratio. Its five PIUs corresponded to four public information categories, since two concerned fee recognition. The added list named these categories and the instruction requested evidence for each; it did not supply the facts reported below. Without the public PIU category labels and instruction, two of five PIUs were substantively communicated in all three repetitions and all final decisions failed. With the public PIU category labels and instruction, all five were communicated, including the 63.4% compensation ratio, the tax-rate change from 20.2% to 26.9% and its explanation, and acquisition consideration of $14.5M plus $4.0M. All three final decisions succeeded. This selected episode illustrates the intervention; the effect estimates use all 59 problem instances.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个使用 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的 HLI 2024 10-Q 问题实例，原始协调者查询询问的是财务重组费用的确认。 被选中的参与者还持有关于收购对价、所得税因素以及季度薪酬比例的证据。 其五个 PIU 对应四个公开信息类别，因为其中两个涉及费用确认。 新增的列表列出了这些类别，并且指令要求提供每一类别的证据；它并未提供下文所报告的事实。 在没有公开 PIU 类别标签和指令的情况下，在全部三次重复中，五个 PIU 中只有两个被实质性传达，且所有最终决策均失败。 在有公开 PIU 类别标签和指令的情况下，全部五个 PIU 均被传达，包括 63.4% 的薪酬比例、税率从 20.2% 到 26.9% 的变化及其解释，以及 1450 万美元加 400 万美元的收购对价。 三次最终决策全部成功。 这个被选中的片段展示了该干预措施；效应估计则使用了全部 59 个问题实例。

paragraphs.en: The fixed-selection interventions identify effects of query content on participant communication and episode success. They do not show that richer participant descriptions improve the coordinator’s selection or its initially generated query. The public PIU category labels and instruction are supplied after selection and their effects are not separated. The design does not separate their effect on the selected participant from their effect on later readers of the transcript. Holding the original Round robin outcomes fixed permits direct estimation of changes in the communication-structure interaction within the same Qwen3 population. The appropriate baseline is the original-query replay, rather than the original single-generation coordinator outcomes. These results support a role for query content in the interaction, but do not establish complete causal mediation, equivalence of the residual interaction to zero, or generalization to an adaptive coordinator or the cross-domain regression.

paragraphs.en: Source material may impair the processing of participants assigned PIUs, or generate additional messages from participants assigned no PIU that impair the final decision. To examine these pathways, we compare Multi-Agent PIU-Only with a condition that adds the original private source material. In both conditions, participants receive their assigned PIUs explicitly as facts relevant to the decision; the added-source condition also supplies source material to participants assigned no PIU. This tests whether source material changes the interaction when the relevant facts are already supplied directly. In Multi-Agent Full-Context, participants instead receive source material from which they must retrieve their assigned PIUs. Explicit availability does not ensure that participants communicate or use the facts correctly. The comparison crosses two PIU distributions, all five communication structures, and these two evidence conditions. The complete design contains 8,100 episodes (45 instances × \times 3 models × \times 2 evidence conditions × \times 2 PIU distributions × \times 5 structures × \times 3 repetitions), with 7,920 primary episodes over 44 instances.
paragraphs.zh: 源材料可能会损害被分配 PIU 的参与者的处理过程，或者使未被分配 PIU 的参与者产生额外消息，从而损害最终决策。 为了检验这些路径，我们将 Multi-Agent PIU-Only 与一个加入原始私有源材料的条件进行比较。 在两种条件下，参与者都会以与决策相关的事实的形式明确收到其被分配的 PIU；加入源材料的条件还会向未被分配 PIU 的参与者提供源材料。 这测试了当相关事实已经被直接提供时，源材料是否会改变交互过程。 在 Multi-Agent Full-Context 中，参与者则收到源材料，并需要从中提取其被分配的 PIU。 明确提供并不能保证参与者正确传达或使用这些事实。 该比较交叉了两种 PIU 分布、全部五种通信结构以及这两种证据条件。 完整设计包含 8,100 个回合（45 个实例 × 3 个模型 × 2 种证据条件 × 2 种 PIU 分布 × 5 种结构 × 3 次重复），其中包含覆盖 44 个实例的 7,920 个主要回合。

paragraphs.en: The preceding comparison changes source-material access for both groups together. Under One PIU per participant, there are no participants assigned no PIU, so the corresponding source-material conditions are identical rather than independent additional observations.

paragraphs.en: Source-material placement changes a participant’s local processing and public messages together. Even if source material for participants assigned no PIU causes the larger loss, this does not establish whether their messages impair final synthesis. If the loss is transmitted through those messages, hiding them only at the final-decision stage should improve episode success when their authors receive source material, with little improvement when they do not. The transcript intervention tests this prediction using frozen All-but-one PIU concentration–Simultaneous responses trajectories from the condition with no added source material and the condition with source material only for participants assigned no PIU. For each trajectory, the final decision maker receives either the complete transcript or only messages from the two participants assigned PIUs. Participant messages, descriptions, PIU assignment, and speaker order remain fixed; only the final decision is regenerated. Both visibility conditions use the same replay implementation, rather than comparing newly generated decisions with archived ones. A separate complete-transcript replay checks stability against archived outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 源材料的放置方式会同时改变参与者的局部处理过程和公开消息。 即使是被分配了无 PIU 的参与者获得的源材料导致了更大的损失，这也不能确定他们的消息是否损害了最终的综合结果。 如果损失是通过这些消息传递的，那么仅在最终决策阶段隐藏这些消息，应当能在其作者获得源材料时提升回合的成功率，而在其作者未获得源材料时几乎没有提升。 转录文本干预通过使用来自未添加源材料的条件以及仅为被分配无 PIU 的参与者提供源材料的条件下的冻结的 All-but-one PIU 集中式–同时响应轨迹来检验这一预测。 对于每条轨迹，最终决策者要么收到完整的转录文本，要么只收到被分配 PIU 的两名参与者的消息。 参与者的消息、描述、PIU 分配和发言顺序保持不变；只有最终决策被重新生成。 两种可见性条件都使用相同的重放实现，而不是将新生成的决策与存档的决策进行比较。 一项单独的完整转录文本重放检验了对存档结果的稳定性。

sents.zh: 源材料的放置方式会同时改变参与者的局部处理过程和公开消息。

sents.en: The transcript intervention tests this prediction using frozen All-but-one PIU concentration–Simultaneous responses trajectories from the condition with no added source material and the condition with source material only for participants assigned no PIU.
sents.zh: 转录文本干预通过使用来自未添加源材料的条件以及仅为被分配无 PIU 的参与者提供源材料的条件下的冻结的 All-but-one PIU 集中式–同时响应轨迹来检验这一预测。

sents.en: For each trajectory, the final decision maker receives either the complete transcript or only messages from the two participants assigned PIUs.
sents.zh: 对于每条轨迹，最终决策者要么收到完整的转录文本，要么只收到被分配 PIU 的两名参与者的消息。

sents.en: Participant messages, descriptions, PIU assignment, and speaker order remain fixed; only the final decision is regenerated.
sents.zh: 参与者的消息、描述、PIU 分配和发言顺序保持不变；只有最终决策被重新生成。

sents.en: Both visibility conditions use the same replay implementation, rather than comparing newly generated decisions with archived ones.
sents.zh: 两种可见性条件都使用相同的重放实现，而不是将新生成的决策与存档的决策进行比较。

sents.en: A separate complete-transcript replay checks stability against archived outcomes.
sents.zh: 一项单独的完整转录文本重放检验了对存档结果的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: This design contains 1,620 episodes (45 instances × \times 3 models × \times 2 source-material conditions × \times 2 message-visibility conditions × \times 3 repetitions), with 1,584 primary episodes over 44 instances. The primary interaction is the effect of removing messages from participants assigned no PIU when those participants receive source material minus the same removal effect when they do not. Confidence intervals use bootstrap sampling over problem instances, preserving matched conditions. For the transcript intervention, overall intervals use 5,000 draws and model-specific intervals use 2,500 draws.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计共包含 1,620 个回合（45 个实例 × \times 3 个模型 × \times 2 种源材料条件 × \times 2 种消息可见性条件 × \times 3 次重复），其中主要回合为覆盖 44 个实例的 1,584 个。 主要交互效应是：对于被分配为无 PIU 的参与者，当其接收源材料时移除消息的效应，减去当其不接收源材料时相同的移除效应。 置信区间采用对问题实例的自助法抽样，并保留匹配条件。 对于对话记录干预，总体区间使用 5,000 次抽样，模型特定区间使用 2,500 次抽样。

paragraphs.en: Adding source material makes concentration additionally harmful under four communication structures; the Coordinator-selected speaker interval includes zero. The Simultaneous responses–Coordinator-selected speaker communication-structure interaction is + 10.6 +10.6 points in Multi-Agent PIU-Only (95% CI [ 2.3 , 19.0 ] [2.3,19.0] ) and − 5.1 -5.1 with added source material ( [ − 13.6 , 3.0 ] [-13.6,3.0] ). The change is − 15.7 -15.7 points ( [ − 26.8 , − 4.3 ] [-26.8,-4.3] ): the − 14.1 -14.1 -point source-material interaction under Simultaneous responses minus the + 1.5 +1.5 -point interaction under Coordinator-selected speaker, calculated before rounding. The negative point estimate in the added-source condition alone does not establish an ordering reversal with statistical confidence, since its interval includes zero.
paragraphs.zh: 添加源材料使得集中（concentration）在四种沟通结构下危害更大；协调者选择发言者（Coordinator-selected speaker）的区间包含零。 同时回答（Simultaneous responses）×协调者选择发言者沟通结构交互效应在仅多智能体 PIU（Multi-Agent PIU-Only）条件下为 +10.6 分（95% CI [2.3, 19.0]），在添加源材料条件下为 −5.1 分（[−13.6, 3.0]）。 该变化为 −15.7 分（[−26.8, −4.3]）：即同时回答条件下 −14.1 分的源材料交互效应减去协调者选择发言者条件下 +1.5 分的交互效应，在四舍五入之前计算。 仅凭添加源材料条件下的负点估计并不能以统计置信度确立顺序反转，因为其区间包含零。

paragraphs.en: Table 43 localizes the larger loss to source material supplied to participants assigned no PIU. Under Simultaneous responses, supplying only that group with source material reduces episode success by 47.2 points (95% CI [ − 55.3 , − 39.1 ] [-55.3,-39.1] ). Supplying only participants assigned PIUs reduces it by 14.9 points ( [ − 23.0 , − 7.1 ] [-23.0,-7.1] ). Once participants assigned no PIU receive source material, adding it for participants assigned PIUs changes episode success by + 0.8 +0.8 points ( [ − 3.0 , 4.3 ] [-3.0,4.3] ). Source material for participants assigned no PIU also has the larger negative point estimate under the two coordinator structures; the size of that difference is not itself tested here.
paragraphs.zh: 表43将较大的损失定位在提供给未分配PIU的参与者的源材料上。 在同时响应条件下，仅向该组提供源材料会使回合成功率降低47.2个点（95% CI [-55.3, -39.1]）。 仅为分配了PIU的参与者提供源材料会使其降低14.9个点（[-23.0, -7.1]）。 一旦未分配PIU的参与者收到了源材料，再为分配了PIU的参与者提供源材料会使回合成功率变化+0.8个点（[-3.0, 4.3]）。 在两种协调员结构下，为未分配PIU的参与者提供源材料的负向点估计值也更大；该差异本身的大小未在此处进行检验。

paragraphs.en: Table 44 reports newly generated final decisions under both message-visibility conditions. Removing messages from participants assigned no PIU improves episode success by 47.7 points when those participants receive source material (95% CI [ 38.9 , 56.3 ] [38.9,56.3] ), compared with − 1.0 -1.0 points when they do not ( [ − 5.3 , 3.3 ] [-5.3,3.3] ). The interaction is + 48.7 +48.7 points ( [ 38.9 , 58.6 ] [38.9,58.6] ). After removal, the added-source minus no-source difference is 0.0 points ( [ − 3.8 , 3.8 ] [-3.8,3.8] ). This is consistent with recovery to the Multi-Agent PIU-Only performance level, but does not establish exact equality.
paragraphs.zh: 表 44 报告了两种消息可见性条件下新生成的最终决策。 当被移除消息的参与者不承担任何 PIU 且能获得源材料时，回合成功率提升 47.7 个百分点（95% CI [38.9, 56.3]）；而当他们不获得源材料时，成功率为 −1.0 个百分点（[−5.3, 3.3]）。 交互效应为 +48.7 个百分点（[38.9, 58.6]）。 移除之后，有源材料减去无源材料的差异为 0.0 个百分点（[−3.8, 3.8]）。 这与恢复到「仅 PIU 的多智能体」（Multi-Agent PIU-Only）性能水平相一致，但并不能证明二者完全相等。

Complete-transcript replay changes episode success relative to archived decisions by only + 0.3 +0.3 points without added source material ( [ − 2.8 , 3.3 ] [-2.8,3.3] ) and − 1.3 -1.3 with it ( [ − 3.8 , 1.5 ] [-3.8,1.5] ), supporting stability of the original difference under final-decision regeneration.

paragraphs.en: Under Simultaneous responses, total message volume from participants assigned no PIU increases from approximately 371 tokens per transcript without source material to 1,396 with source material only for that group. The messages from participants assigned PIUs remain approximately 204 tokens per transcript in both conditions. These are pooled group totals, rather than per-message lengths, and therefore can exceed the 600-token participant cap. The transcript intervention retains the messages communicating assigned PIUs while removing the messages through which source material supplied to the other participants reaches the final decision maker.
paragraphs.zh: 在同时回复模式下，被分配无 PIU 的参与者的总消息量从不提供源材料时每份记录约 371 个词元，增加到仅该组提供源材料时的 1,396 个词元。 被分配 PIU 的参与者的消息量在两种条件下均保持每份记录约 204 个词元。 这些是汇总的群体总量，而非单条消息的长度，因此可能超过每个参与者 600 词元的上限。 记录干预保留了传达所分配 PIU 的消息，同时删除了提供给其他参与者的源材料藉以传达给最终决策者的消息。

paragraphs.en: The transcript intervention identifies a harmful contribution of messages from participants assigned no PIU at the final-decision stage, under All-but-one PIU concentration and Simultaneous responses. It does not separate transcript length, distracting content, contradictory reasoning, and the final model’s allocation of attention. It directly tests source material supplied only to participants assigned no PIU; it does not establish the same removal effect when all participants receive source material or under other communication structures. Nor does it imply that contributions from participants assigned no PIU are generally unhelpful. Because the follow-ups supply exact PIUs as well as source material, they support a mechanism relevant to the cross-domain Full-Context pattern without constituting a direct re-estimation or complete causal explanation of that regression interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 该文本记录层面的干预分析识别出，在「除一人外均集中PIU」（All-but-one PIU concentration）与「同时回复」（Simultaneous responses）条件下，处于最终决策阶段时，被分配无PIU角色的参与者的消息所造成的有害影响。 它并未区分文本长度、干扰性内容、相互矛盾的推理，以及最终模型注意力的分配方式。 它直接检验的是仅提供给被分配无PIU角色的参与者的原始素材；它并未确立当所有参与者都获得原始素材时，或在其他沟通结构下，是否存在同样的移除效应。 它也不意味着被分配无PIU角色的参与者所作的贡献总体上是无益的。 由于后续实验同时提供了确切的PIU和原始素材，它们支持了一种与跨领域「全上下文」（Full-Context）模式相关的机制，但并不构成对该回归交互作用的直接重新估计或完整的因果解释。

sents.zh: 我们在下面保留完整的结果呈现，随后是额外的实现细节、预算约束诊断，以及按模型和来源语料库划分的结果。

paragraphs.en: We study private-note, message, and local-transcript token budgets under Multi-Agent Full-Context with One PIU per participant and Coordinator-selected speaker. For a problem instance with N N participants, every budget setting permits N N participant messages before the final decision. We hold the coordinator policy and final-decision token budget fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在「多智能体全上下文、每名参与者一个 PIU、由协调者选择发言者」的设置下，研究私人便签、消息以及本地记录的 token 预算。 对于有 N 名参与者的问题实例，每种预算设置都允许在最终决策之前进行 N 轮参与者消息。 我们保持协调者策略和最终决策的 token 预算固定不变。

sents.en: We study private-note, message, and local-transcript token budgets under Multi-Agent Full-Context with One PIU per participant and Coordinator-selected speaker.
sents.zh: 我们在「多智能体全上下文、每名参与者一个 PIU、由协调者选择发言者」的设置下，研究私人便签、消息以及本地记录的 token 预算。

sents.en: For a problem instance with N N participants, every budget setting permits N N participant messages before the final decision.
sents.zh: 对于有 N 名参与者的问题实例，每种预算设置都允许在最终决策之前进行 N 轮参与者消息。

sents.en: We hold the coordinator policy and final-decision token budget fixed.
sents.zh: 我们保持协调者策略和最终决策的 token 预算固定不变。

paragraphs.en: Each participant message is generated in two stages. The participant first forms a private working note from its initial local observation and local transcript. A second stage receives the note and the same local transcript and produces the message added to the communication transcript; the note is not shared. The message token budget makes the departure from A3 explicit. Because participants receive source material containing their PIUs rather than the PIUs alone, they must identify the information needed for a correct final decision before producing bounded messages, a requirement related to A2 . We cross private-note token budgets of 64, 128, and 256 tokens with message token budgets of 32, 64, 128, and 256 tokens. Table 45 reports GPT-5.5 results over 24 CUAD and 29 Multi-LexSum problem instances; Section E.8.2 provides the complete implementation and results by model and source corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 每条参与者消息分两个阶段生成。 参与者首先根据其初始局部观察和局部对话记录形成一份私密工作笔记。 第二阶段接收该笔记和同一份局部对话记录，并生成被添加到通信对话记录中的消息；该笔记不会被共享。 消息的令牌预算使与 A3 的偏离变得明确。 由于参与者收到的是包含其 PIU 的原始材料而非仅 PIU 本身，他们必须在生成有长度限制的消息之前识别出做出正确最终决策所需的信息，这一要求与 A2 相关。 我们将 64、128 和 256 个令牌的私密笔记令牌预算与 32、64、128 和 256 个令牌的消息令牌预算进行交叉组合。 表 45 报告了 GPT-5.5 在 24 个 CUAD 和 29 个 Multi-LexSum 问题实例上的结果；第 E.8.2 节提供了按模型和来源语料库划分的完整实现与结果。

sents.zh: 每条参与者消息分两个阶段生成。

sents.zh: 参与者首先根据其初始局部观察和局部对话记录形成一份私密工作笔记。

sents.zh: 消息的令牌预算使与 A3 的偏离变得明确。

sents.en: We cross private-note token budgets of 64, 128, and 256 tokens with message token budgets of 32, 64, 128, and 256 tokens.
sents.zh: 我们将 64、128 和 256 个令牌的私密笔记令牌预算与 32、64、128 和 256 个令牌的消息令牌预算进行交叉组合。

sents.en: Table 45 reports GPT-5.5 results over 24 CUAD and 29 Multi-LexSum problem instances; Section E.8.2 provides the complete implementation and results by model and source corpus.
sents.zh: 表 45 报告了 GPT-5.5 在 24 个 CUAD 和 29 个 Multi-LexSum 问题实例上的结果；第 E.8.2 节提供了按模型和来源语料库划分的完整实现与结果。

paragraphs.en: We separately limit the newly available message text in each participant’s local transcript. This limit is motivated by work on limited human attention and working memory ( Kahneman, 1973 ; Cowan, 2001 ) , without assuming that language models share the same cognitive mechanisms. We compare first-in, first-out (FIFO) and random contiguous-window reading with GPT-5.5 on the 29 Multi-LexSum problem instances. Section E.8.3 provides the complete implementation and reports how often the token budgets bind.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个参与者的本地记录中新增可用的消息文本分别设置限制。 该限制的动机来自关于人类注意力与工作记忆有限性的研究（Kahneman, 1973; Cowan, 2001），但并不假设语言模型共享相同的认知机制。 我们在 29 个 Multi-LexSum 问题实例上，将先进先出（FIFO）与随机连续窗口读取方式与 GPT-5.5 进行了比较。 E.8.3 节提供了完整的实现，并报告了 token 预算达到上限的频率。

sents.zh: 我们对每个参与者的本地记录中新增可用的消息文本分别设置限制。
